name: David Horowitz Freedom Center
subject: Barack Obama’s revolution
body:
I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers...| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=b82339c7ff0a4080882441e0e7e0074a&_e=JjSJXap-N5YItiQW6YQG10T3vSrgNDrmD9MGLdW83HvriUkz6Vq-JN2IFxLFgSljYiDyjYo4JQj-OHN2HLhqog0v9q1nTW4xBpgIKogZkB7r4tkj4AEX1FAqVmqIJmHYUDibJWb1irUHZaawRTUKnLggKaba_skEI8KwbZZAQHzAZqBMNPlWhmDyAvHCyXxA648F3GZT_eC_PQMmaM7Mv08Jg3q0F4daaqJwcT_1dDRfDpDCwwuBBM5sjdkRlDDVdHYK2Oja-O52D50vhZioDwkoE8Rc20YomGXqVC1ypM2OvYDv8zlCXEPL435r9L9EMpObqqo5R-m7qT7QmkEWHjfaZDYP6XeWamukJ3J-DroX9V027lAjmIsOWog-D5pF9kXnJeEluv4V9VvR_qe-Tl9sBQGGLQ-UpUPB5hoJQwE%3D)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=b82339c7ff0a4080882441e0e7e0074a&_e=JjSJXap-N5YItiQW6YQG10T3vSrgNDrmD9MGLdW83HvriUkz6Vq-JN2IFxLFgSljYiDyjYo4JQj-OHN2HLhqog0v9q1nTW4xBpgIKogZkB7r4tkj4AEX1FAqVmqIJmHYUDibJWb1irUHZaawRTUKnLggKaba_skEI8KwbZZAQHzAZqBMNPlWhmDyAvHCyXxA648F3GZT_eC_PQMmaM7Mv08Jg3q0F4daaqJwcT_1dDRfDpDCwwuBBM5sjdkRlDDVeKPlGB4JumAJV_nSYl5QNNeoRCY7Ot_I-hz2i2FRzzo6DjFJp2JsrIs5OB0X_BpDMWwXopKuBKLe_VmZMtwJsDfnfr7AP6JAZvHWzfc0hyCMoFmudzKHdtc5dmh1gOrwPA5WeUpQDOsC8adV5oQxO3KOOPE0dZSTKeZah1mrXv4%3D)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---
| | Sincerely,
---
---
David Horowitz

Still, a messaging orthodoxy has a hold on many. Despite the sobering loss and the well-reasoned conclusion that we need to figure out how to better connect with everyday Americans, Seth received a media backlash for attempting to do just that. I've seen memos from FOUR different agencies this evening that order an immediate BLACKOUT of all government data, reports and information.
This will have immediate life and death consequences and must NOT be allowed to stand.
The importance of data continuity in climate science (and I imagine most sciences) cannot be overstated.
Governments and organizations rely on robust climate data to inform policies on emissions reductions, disaster preparedness, and resource management. Gaps in data continuity could lead to less informed or less effective decision-making.
Continuous data allows scientists to monitor the frequency and intensity of extreme weather events, such as hurricanes, heatwaves, and floods. Understanding changes in these events is crucial for risk assessment and mitigation.
Climate systems are interconnected, involving the atmosphere, oceans, land, and biosphere. Continuous data helps track interactions between these systems over time, providing a comprehensive understanding of climate dynamics.
I have found myself completely stunned, and I honestly didn't think that was possible with these people.
This is where our public servants must stop in.
DO NOT COMPLY.

body:
Voters desperately need a " private right to action " to protect their rights. All that phrase means is that we, the people, can bring forward a lawsuit ourselves when we see wrongdoing in our elections.
This 8th Circuit decision strips us of that -- in a world where most legal action around voting rights comes from groups like ours and our partners, not from the U.S. Department of Justice(DOJ). And we're starting four years of DOJ's Civil Rights division facing attacks from a hostile presidential administration.
There's so much at risk, Team. RUSH $25 or more right now so we have the resources we need to fight rulings like this one and protect our right to vote across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=012325_2&amount=25]
AP: Federal appeals court deals a blow to Voting Rights Act, ruling that private plaintiffs can’t sue [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=012325_2&amount=25]
Folks,
As we assess threats with Trump back in office, this ruling by the federal 8th Circuit stands out like a sore thumb. It's one of the most dangerous anti-voter rulings we’ve seen in years .
If you missed the details, the impact is pretty simple to understand: In the eight states impacted by the ruling, voters and voting rights organizations can no longer sue to overturn unjust laws under the Voting Rights Act. According to the 8th Circuit, only the Department of Justice (DoJ) has the legal standing to sue states over voting laws.
Whether former Florida AG Pam Bondi gets confirmed for Attorney General or we get stuck with another anti-voting MAGA acolyte, do any of us really think that the DOJ is going to protect voting rights over the next four years?
Team, we have to fight this ruling and make sure voters and advocacy groups have the right to defend voting rights in court. Please pitch in $25 or whatever you can to make every vote count, either at the ballot box or in court >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=012325_2&amount=25]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=012325_2&amount=250]
Other Amount [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=012325_2&amount=35]
This is all about the legal term "private right of action". The 8th Circuit says it doesn't exist. That means the pro-voting lawsuits we've seen in states like Wisconsin, Georgia, Florida, and others nationwide wouldn't be possible anymore if the Supreme Court backs up this ruling.
We won’t sugarcoat this: This could be a crushing blow to many voting rights organizations across the country, ourselves included. If this ruling is not overturned by a higher court, it could unravel all of the great work pro-voting organizations are doing across the country — and allow dozens of unjust, unconstitutional voter restrictions to stand.
Attacks like this on what remains of the Voting Rights Act are going to get worse over the next few years. As voter suppression laws become increasingly targeted and oppressive , our work to combat them must become smarter, stronger, and more accessible to everyone.
We can't do this alone. Help defend our right to vote with $25 or however much you can today and make every voice heard in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=012325_2&amount=25]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=012325_2&amount=25]

Although Trump and the extremist GOP’s win dealt a devastating blow to our democracy and fair elections, the NDRC fought and won in a number of key races. These Democracy Defenders who we helped elect are prepared to stand up to gerrymandering and serve as a backstop to extreme anti-democracy agendas.
We’ve always known that the fight against gerrymandering would be a marathon, not a sprint. When maps are drawn so that politicians pick their voters — rather than the voters picking their politicians — our democracy is not truly representative. Corruption breeds and extremism thrives. Gerrymandering makes it harder for all voices to be heard and for communities to be truly represented.
Donald Trump’s second presidency offers an opportunity for us to wake up each day and get back to work, fighting for our democracy and for fair representation. **That’s what we’ll be doing every day here at the NDRC — are you with us?**

name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: I’m running for Governor of Michigan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Friend,

“We have a responsibility to ensure that everyone gets a fair shot in life.”

That’s what my parents taught me growing up, and I’ve carried that lesson every step of my life — from my time as a voting rights lawyer, to leading Wayne State Law School, to serving as Secretary of State.

**I’m running for Governor of Michigan to continue that work and make sure that every Michigan family has that fair shot.**

[If you’re with me, will you make a founding contribution of any amount today to my campaign and Voter Protection Project? »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/86430?t=6&akid=18676%2E878179%2EmIE5dp)

I’m ready for this work. I’ve investigated radical extremist groups, taught civil rights and voting rights law, and I ran for Secretary of State to make sure government is efficient and transparent, that every voice is heard, and that every legitimate vote is counted.

Some people didn’t like that very much — but I’ve never backed down from a tough fight. I’ve spent my life standing up to powerful interests, and I’ll keep standing up to any bullies or billionaires who try to deceive us, divide us, take away our rights, or deprive us of our opportunities.

**I’m running for Governor to truly make government work for everyone.** We need transparent leadership, safe schools and neighborhoods, and good education and childcare. Every Michigander should be able to pay their bills, put food on the table, and take care of their families.

[That’s what I’m ready to fight for as Michigan’s next Governor. Please, will you chip in $7 today to my campaign and Voter Protection Project to become a founding donor and help us launch this campaign? »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/86430?t=7&akid=18676%2E878179%2EmIE5dp) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Jocelyn Benson and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/86431?t=8&akid=18676%2E878179%2EmIE5dp)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/86432?t=9&akid=18676%2E878179%2EmIE5dp)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/86433?t=10&akid=18676%2E878179%2EmIE5dp)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/86434?t=11&akid=18676%2E878179%2EmIE5dp)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/86435?t=12&akid=18676%2E878179%2EmIE5dp)
I love Michigan and I believe in our future. We’re tough, we work hard, and we never back down from a fight. Let’s make Michigan the best place to be a kid, raise a kid, stay, and call home.

I can’t do this without you. Working together, I know we can do all of this, and more.

Let’s go.

— Jocelyn Benson

Friend,

My mind is still going a million miles an hour, and with everything racing through my head right now, I'm overwhelmed with gratitude.

So I wanted to take a minute to reflect on the incredible journey that led me here. **[SECURE VP MEMO](https://link.donaldjtrump.com/u/click?_t=c26d591425684a3289b90149d613a03c&_m=4f37498b7609461e9615596979113f94&_e=HKHOuBax3Hr75LSEabeIZopyHE1VD2Kl9vfRd4Yjuz31FKep4EblYIo0jv6jhRK-jqxvxfLbXABsSGkqrPZMIKIzvaZ8QjeWMVVh7v0uxLR5QYEHTFEiDfrJb7Mm2uRQ4nCAL7KUvwA7O7fwqeG8OoXR4LK1AYpMScK0sr9p8BIxwMi_PAVHHkc2mw56mKa5jGZt-glslErZcf0rWokTlNDsF4DXxcWODjP0RAQhYQp-S728vzSKPK1JwMqdMrvBbB5Su4glp1JXVx6WaBa2tc6gjdIpKbtPV9wNMDfBFSK-yzsSrdpsBeJKUNZCa94HbT6KYzywNNZXhE6NDR0SKne3AjsWookwXQI6gdjq_keD6blcwXMuQHZT-PzH1wpfG_9vjPB4Ln5bBWv2LlWcVRbeQ2M6MMfhDoXvsz6HDg6yVwati95ISV8cQaznK79Vh85OQGx7XsZNiqVqkTcBt4_5-s_ROi6HdzerULBB_p2blTgXKV3NTkAweaSs4L7c)**
Hillbilly, author, Marine, Senator -- and now, VICE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES.

Who would've thought a kid from Middletown could one day make it to the White House?

Not me, never in my wildest dreams.

As you probably know already, I didn't grow up with a silver spoon in my mouth like so many of the career politicians I've had the misfortune of working within the D.C. swamp.

I grew up poor, in the Rust Belt, in a small Ohio town that had been losing jobs and hope for generations.

My Mamaw -- God rest her soul -- would go into medical debt just to put food on the table. Some nights, she didn't even have enough money to turn on the heat in the dead of winter.

In Middletown, hard-working families that gave everything they had to achieve the American Dream watched helplessly as their jobs were shipped overseas.

The statistics tell you that kids like me face a grim future - that if they're lucky, they'll manage to avoid welfare

I was one of those kids with a grim future, but through hard work, grit, determination, and the love of my grandparents, I made it out.

First to the Marines where I was deployed to Iraq, then to Yale where I met my incredible wife, and eventually all the way to the U.S. Senate where I faithfully served the great people of Ohio.

But the real honor of my lifetime came from President Trump, when he gave me the privilege of joining his ticket.

He called me and said, look, I think we've gotta go save this country, I think you're the guy who could help me in the best way. You can help me govern, you could help me win.

And after a whirlwind campaign - one that featured a second failed assassination attempt, a political coup of the sitting president, and a landslide victory - we stand at the precious of the four greatest years in American history.

President Trump and I are ready to keep the American Dream alive for future generations and restore this country's great promise, but we can't do it alone.

Who would've thought a kid from Middletown could one day make it to the White House? Not me, never in my wildest dreams. As you probably know already, I didn't grow up with a silver spoon in my mouth like so many of the career politicians I've had the misfortune of working within the D.C. swamp. I grew up poor, in the Rust Belt, in a small Ohio town that had been losing jobs and hope for generations. My Mamaw -- God rest her soul -- would go into medical debt just to put food on the table. Some nights, she didn't even have enough money to turn on the heat in the dead of winter. In Middletown, hard-working families that gave everything they had to achieve the American Dream watched helplessly as their jobs were shipped overseas. The statistics tell you that kids like me face a grim future - that if they're lucky, they'll manage to avoid welfare I was one of those kids with a grim future, but through hard work, grit, determination, and the love of my grandparents, I made it out. First to the Marines where I was deployed to Iraq, then to Yale where I met my incredible wife, and eventually all the way to the U.S. Senate where I faithfully served the great people of Ohio. But the real honor of my lifetime came from President Trump, when he gave me the privilege of joining his ticket. He called me and said, look, I think we've gotta go save this country, I think you're the guy who could help me in the best way. You can help me govern, you could help me win. And after a whirlwind campaign - one that featured a second failed assassination attempt, a political coup of the sitting president, and a landslide victory - we stand at the precious of the four greatest years in American history. President Trump and I are ready to keep the American Dream alive for future generations and restore this country's great promise, but we can't do it alone. Friend, together we will MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN! Friend,

Just when you thought things couldn’t get any weirder in California, we find out that the reason for the catastrophic failure to combat the Los Angeles County fires is due to the state’s insane Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) policies!

That’s right...

The new mission of the Los Angeles Fire Department (LAFD), according to its DEI hire, Chief Kristina Crowley, is “the creation of systemic equity and inclusion across the LAFD.”
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z2tp9vt14sjv99oaemk5sfc1134pgc7cjii4cjc8_rp22sh2s8i6epj7ctg69oj1c1h2bs)
This is UNACCEPTABLE.

The only questions that should matter when hiring or promoting within a fire department are:

_“Can you pull a grown man out of a building? Can you FIGHT a wildfire?”_

Friend, this is how California got itself into the devastating mess it’s in now, but there is hope.

And that hope comes in the form of President Donald Trump.

The promise of his return to the White House provides an opportunity for America and, yes, _even California_ to sever all ties with the DEI agenda and return to a system of meritocracy that elevates everyone according to his or her effort and ability.

Until then, we must reflect on and learn from the ongoing disaster, the magnitude of which is hard to comprehend...

27 dead.
22 missing.
150,000 displaced.
13,600 structures destroyed.
Catastrophic loss of pets and wildlife.

Friend, this is what’s at stake for our nation. We must band together to elect more America First candidates who are committed to upholding meritocracy and defending traditional American values over equity.

If we don’t, our very lives could be at stake.

body:
Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts

| [](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zenk10m6b0qr99qnfoq18l6cae7mt7adrvbf1j08_rp22sh2s8i6epj7ctg69oj1c1h2bs)

[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z9adoeig9io4cjm8b8559erh9ur9aaphm321ivag_rp22sh2s8i6epj7ctg69oj1c1h2bs)
**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's [hear.com's](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zppr8m75holuap38kvcc9cdnpchktkeqbjfkgao8_rp22sh2s8i6epj7ctg69oj1c1h2bs) **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **[hear.com's](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z10q1s9i8deu22psoahl6vqru8m6ue5q8ng6qcco_rp22sh2s8i6epj7ctg69oj1c1h2bs) IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[Check if you qualify](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2ztqch3d1g9lu37km6e2lbgdq8ea1rgc1c7hsao8o_rp22sh2s8i6epj7ctg69oj1c1h2bs)
[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zlrd0jtvs0n6jpt1oj41mcekpmvndf843slm2d60_rp22sh2s8i6epj7ctg69oj1c1h2bs)

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that [hear.com's](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zehs413t2q5h9bi47hl1p17nld5sbnf9p8mh81c0_rp22sh2s8i6epj7ctg69oj1c1h2bs) IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains [hear.com's](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2ze2gok0lt3jfvpnb4bmv73rfcmp8c69rrsmf44lo_rp22sh2s8i6epj7ctg69oj1c1h2bs) founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

As both an immigrant to Israel of 20 years and the father of two soldiers, I am telling you from my experience that such support could truly make the difference between life and death. **We 're so close to reaching our $1 million match but we're still falling short.** **[Show your support for Israel's soldiers today and keep God's children safe!](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zj5ia47suaq3se2rche54r52chjrn4j8n7q8at10_rp22sh2s8i6epj7cti64o76clh2bs "Show your support for Israel’s soldiers today and keep God’s children safe!")** Every prayer. name: Lila Rose, Live Action
subject: You can send diapers to the fire victims
body:
As you’ve most likely seen, parts of beautiful Southern California are being destroyed by ruthless flames.

| [ ](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zsuqmj6v9egitpvam2uq99cpo169ook3ndim2gio_rp22sh2s8i6epj7cti64o71clh2bs)
---
#
Friend of Life,

As you've most likely seen, parts of beautiful Southern California are being destroyed by ruthless flames.

My family and I are safe, but many are not. As we pray for the protection of all those in the fire's path, there is something else you can do to help these victims.

Live Action is partnering with EveryLife to send diapers to families impacted by the fires. From now through the end of the month, every gift of $50, using this link, will enable a box of diapers (6 packs!) to be sent to a family in critical need. Will you step up now for these families? [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z6gs2720dcirquqfnp8iqmifsgcefia7fjnpjumg_rp22sh2s8i6epj7cti64o71clh2bs)
With 5 already dead and over 2,000 buildings destroyed, news reports are saying this is one of the most destructive fires in recorded history for this region of California.

Over 130,000 have been evacuated so far and many are struggling to meet basic needs, unsure what they'll be returning to after the flames subside.

In these stressful moments, practical necessities make all the difference, especially when babies are involved. That's why we're partnering with EveryLife to provide diapers to families in need.

EveryLife is coordinating with CityServe and Convoy of Hope, working tirelessly to ensure the diapers reach California families in need by any means necessary.

This means all you need to do is fill out the donation form with a gift of $50 or more, and the rest will be taken care of for you.

Send a box containing 6 packs of diapers to a family in need: **[https://give.liveaction.org/ca-wildfires-diaper-drive/](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z46i5t07r6uubihvul1c39po4k0maries0per1v0_rp22sh2s8i6epj7cti64o71clh2bs)**

Thank you for standing with us to help children and families affected during this critical time.

For Life,

Lila Rose
**Founder and President**

[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zv1s3hr9mkj3kg4ic36kac0sn5bvc4oeemimh3ag_rp22sh2s8i6epj7cti64o71clh2bs)

2200 Wilson Blvd, Suite 102, PMB 111 Arlington, VA 22201

Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts

| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z2svdm3421oi2aa00fhbu4t327ck1hvi4prqrd38_rp22sh2s8i6epj7cti62or6cjh2bs)

---
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z91769a124751j3ut61pdh2td99prtqn4k00bcqg_rp22sh2s8i6epj7cti62or6cjh2bs)
**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's [hear.com's](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zndkci7jn54qmr6dqi0p6hmnjh5nm2j2jdduoaj0_rp22sh2s8i6epj7cti62or6cjh2bs) **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **[hear.com's](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zim2kmg3ptk23h0jcs84arfk9sti2pp2k54tffp8_rp22sh2s8i6epj7cti62or6cjh2bs) IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[Check if you qualify](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zsrgtpfq7t11q5inifg8sg1d2ij301fov6106cl0_rp22sh2s8i6epj7cti62or6cjh2bs)
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zr8uftkdlgp606eg9t9fq92vhre3dtbffc4b8vtg_rp22sh2s8i6epj7cti62or6cjh2bs)
What makes [hear.com's](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zto65qe74fb9ech4pfa5jbnkn1g6s873gq6mdo0o_rp22sh2s8i6epj7cti62or6cjh2bs) IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that [hear.com's](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zus4i930mh5059d0dvdsq2ocgeq9qpivbn9qqra0_rp22sh2s8i6epj7cti62or6cjh2bs) IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains [hear.com's](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zdrqq2ih1bkr8kd80l1i8umgujhmtde1v1sh9nq0_rp22sh2s8i6epj7cti62or6cjh2bs) founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

## Seven San Antonio Officers Shot, Expected to Recover
Seven San Antonio police officers were shot Wednesday night during a [standoff at an apartment complex](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00Luq8zAQBOCnsTsFab26uFDxN-nyt6c0G13iBcUylsjl7Q9Jf8ph4GOYn8tyIS683f7TPfn-ynUBCVpIJQCXSFzeC47RX2Wc1Zi8spO1yqFx4-qDcsZdJ1JGZ4gzmQgQQOOVjJbg4sj-g0kFqNSEEk-YJFGQIK212mkYUKbIvR6nvqaeXtRyeddHOk6h3sfi1973Nkz_BjgPcKZ9S8_2qT7h6BxKGuDcaBO09bpxFXstHJKoOXNIRxNtrV18YaEs5hjdNM0GHCEggnYuo8SZZtR5PHzcn1wKN2MHlLc7cfnu6H8e8_DwGwAA__9zvmMa) while responding to a suicide call. The officers were treated at a local hospital, and none of their injuries are believed to be life-threatening. After the first responding officer was shot in the leg, six more officers were subsequently shot before a SWAT team [arrived on the scene](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHOozAQhJ_GdIvWi8FQuLiGLtdeiRy8BB8ORtiJk7c_cf3fjTSjmdH35zbdrA9-f_y2Tzb5s8SJkFpACaQmZ334Tqpy5o5ukBUbqRutZa-6vlrNnecBSQ4zdoqbRduh1f3Qdy2pFkm1lTdXGUpSUjYKVa0YrZ2RUGvd9i0Jhex8jmedV878sWkJ3_jms57jswpmzflIovklaBQ0llLqLdl8mYLGnUsSNIY42yBovKYEjSgv3Vzx1WYoDNseC2hI9nAQl8XPfCbw-9_XyQ78DinHnSHaDdIaY_b7A9IrHTxn2HwI7ASN1WncUXwIPnVaKHw8rQ__T-Yfqb0N_QsAAP__eI1tfA). The suspect, 46-year-old Navy veteran Brandon Scott Poulos, was killed several hours after barricading himself in the apartment. Poulos had been [out on bond](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2O6yAUBOCnwR0Wfw52QXEbd7ntltYxHGIkDBaQOHn7lVfbbvdJI41G83Vf7hBiSI__sKNpb58XwcRAGadCLQ5C_Cyqc2ZlbuIdGq6l1nxUt7HbjBy8V6tScmLWrpPTCqx03g5WrpNH6IK5yhgXinOpmOoVMgDLBNNaD-MgiGLoQsulbxs2fEP18ZNfWHqb9y6arbWjEvmPiJmI-TzPPq024VmvnIj5IhHzs9Jf7ZBo3XJulR45Bos0ex8slkotxIiO1mewwSE9Sn4UrJVWSBRSyynQYhPwcZyY6IpxxxliDPWmiWKPHUL8GdX-fOllxHcAAAD__wCvbEs) following charges of assault and DWI earlier this month. It is unclear if his death was self-inflicted or due to gunfire from SWAT officers.
## House, Senate Unveil Budget Proposals
The Texas House and Senate [unveiled their budget proposals](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L-OszAQBPCnMR1o13-wKVx8DV2-9kq02OtgyYQc-ELy9qekv_43M9J8XaYL5ZJv1_-0sq_PtE0SpGkBW6mnSLm8Jt1EP0McsGGPVlmLTveuWbw1SqMKJroetYupH2blXJJzIk2Bhyb7dxmg1IhKg-40A1EACdZa44wUGjjmuu1dXbjyk45UXtuD9y5sa1P8Uuv9EOqfkKOQ43mebxf4Vnk_vn9o57cTcvxEhRxprzkUnggUm-SgjUPAFpFTS30_t1YxoDGgDLpuqWtpdh_vZy4lH70VGq4r5fIZr3--8fDyNwAA__84s19L) for the upcoming 2026-27 biennium, with both chambers allocating substantial funding for property tax cuts, school choice, and border security efforts. The House budget is $335.7 billion, while the Senate's is $332.9 billion. Just over $150 billion of each budget comes from general revenue--the funding source that legislators have the most control over--with the rest coming from dedicated state funds and federal funds. The [current two-year budget](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7FugzAQQL_G3mKdzwdHBg9d2NK1IzrgAEumRODS5O-rZs_-3pPe1627Scrpe_6UVWN5TFuHgNUF_AWpGyXlZ0d2jD2MV281eg7MvqG6sUvkoFchZR5qbjyJhn6qBuG-rgl8YJvifww8kveBgBwpiAyAwMxVU6Eh0DGVbXdl0aIPOab83E7d3bCtNsellPthwofB1mA7HT8u9717gW7eToOt3eN4_005p6NmQzCvkvLLLm93zoh_AQAA___czEtJ) is $321.7 billion. Both budgets allocate approximately [$30 billion to maintain property tax cuts](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOgzAQRL_GdEb2YrApXFxDl2uvRAteyEoORsYJyd-fkuqa60Yz0tPo_VzGC3Lkbf3GG_nyXNIIClqptAQzBuT4Gk0V_KRCryvy2jbWamc6V129c32rqJutnpCoCzMaDG2vguuXdultxf4NUxqM1o1RpjakEGcFylrbuhaEURS4pFyXKxV64rHEV3pQrud0q6K_lrIfovkSMAgYzvOst2kOy_meBQwbnYeAYU-RC8_vGNNG8iiY5Z_yA5aRVj4ilnsmOd3DSkXuOe3pwCj3zClzeQkYGmucs07AUGUf9pNj5KOzwqj1hhw_x8q_ph4efgMAAP__KRtspw) approved by lawmakers two years ago, $1 billion for some form of school choice program, and $6.5 billion to secure the border and counter illegal immigration. Notably, each version also includes [$3 billion for dementia research](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOszAQBOCnMR1ovSx2KFz8DV3-9kpkvCa25MTIOCF5-xPpr52RvpHm5zpfbUzxcftv797U95pnBBxakC3SzDamz0wNmwV4lI03UvdaywupSxPMgsjMI-rR8gqsVzWwsnoBGPteOWqiOTGQSFL2BNSRB2sdIGith8uAgsBzrLl0Nfjq33Zf0ye_fOlcvjfJhFq3XfT_BE4Cp-M4OhdKfpytwGnLKdbodoGTLTW65AVOX6VFQNUuT7752r7y0wVfzhBopF53W9iaYng7YkpxV1oQ3O42pu9q_fOGl8HfAAAA__8KOl5o), and the Senate's draft proposes increasing teacher pay by at least $4,000. Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick touted the state's "conservative approach to budgeting," [saying the bill](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOszAQhJ_GdEbrxWBSuPgbuvztlWiJF7DO4Aj2IHn7U5L6utXO6JvRfF37K8UU1-k_LezlMeYeAWsNRqPtA8X07G0R_ADhYgr2xlXOmdY2bTH7IdClZWfR1GNtHDRggCuunaUBG2iK6F8wMGiNqSzY0jIQ3QDBOVe3NSoLHKLkrZSZhR-0j-mZD97KW16K5GeR-66qfwo7hd15nmWSKR_l21pO-VDYvSIUdmBeNyrskugpHzrQqu8kW7x9611IeOFVdF61zPx56OEnTCx6jImDjh_ljdY7rySssCs2H-5nTCnujVMWpoViereTP-c6PP4GAAD__xlFa9E) "maintains our promise to Texans by keeping our state on a conservative path to greater prosperity."
## Gators Survive Freezing Temps
Alligators in Southeast Texas weathered freezing temperatures this week by [employing a survival tactic](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOszAQhJ8GOtB6vWAoXPxNuvztlWhjm2Bpg5GxQnJPfyK69rpPM9I30nxdpytHiev9Pz-CLa85TQjYNaAapMlzlPdEtbc38KOqg1VGG6MG6od6sWA8Qj8zjN2gnfY3p7kbHJHWA5se62hPGSgkpTQBtRSA2QGCMaYbOqwIgo8l5bYsoYQX77O80zPk1qVHLXYpZdsr_a_CS4WX4zhat-S0nm2FF4lzOOMo_hc5l-jkpDmn77A2LBLvXFLem4--QQAaicZ2W7Y6W78dUSTuvakI7g-O8lkuf17xtPgTAAD__zNcX94) that lowers their heart rate to about three beats a minute. >From mid-October to early March, the cold-blooded reptiles [enter a state called brumation](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO2zAQRL-G6lYg15QoFSycQkWCSxsgjcATV9IGFHkgacvO1wd2n3YGeDN4vz7mD8eB4_bTHWTrY00zSuxAKkA9e8fhOevG20_pR9WQVeZijBp0PzS7XSX1KMd1NUq50SAadGYY_SD7Tg9maNi-YFKhVuqipW41SecWidIY0w0dCi3Jc025rTtVeriyhme6U26XdDTB7rV-FXG5CpwETud5tkeJr07gRBFuReBUFqa40CtZUkjbU-D051Yq7OmEJQUPnj284bBRBX_LHDfItFCscHKslOEzuFLBhcCbqykXWHP6S8ARSgrsgd8DLsP1qh4_vn_73WTrv04OgUtvhJbb4Ti8X9f_arxb_BcAAP__v0R15w) that causes them to become deeply lethargic. During extreme cold, alligators submerge themselves in water, leaving only their snouts exposed to breathe. Photos shared this week by Gator Country in Beaumont—where the temperature plunged to 11 degrees, the coldest it’s been in nearly 120 years—show several motionless alligators brumating under a frozen pond. The rescue center’s co-owner, Gary Saurage, [posted a video](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0jz2P8jAQhH9N0hGt1-uPFC7eJh1ve2Vk7A1YGIzCHoF_f8r1185o5tHzdZyPsdRyP_-PNw7yXtqMgOYA6oA051jqZ6Y-hxPkUfUclNPOKU_W95fgR6tPJ1aYlshGWSDt2WYeDadFJ9eXsJ-BQlJKE9BADDEmQHDOGW-wI-BcpK2DXFj4HZ9L_bQXr0Nqt76Gi8jj2el_HU4dTtu2DVKu0q57vWcE5yhtTe37LutH3h1Or5K5dTg5sugV-lETOO3RK9OvIT-2Umt5Wrdvb7HUX5L8qf4K-BMAAP__VoNY1w) with his commentary on social media. “ _Isn't that crazy y'all? ## Trump Orders Release of JFK Files
President Trump signed an executive order Thursday to declassify remaining files related to the assassinations of President John F. Kennedy, Senator Robert F. Kennedy, and Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Read the [executive order here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvwyAUhH8N3rDggU0yMHTxlq4dLQIP-6UEIkNj5d9XztCt83367nRfl_niKFFePt0dbYtlBgEDF5KDnoOj9Jp1F2xEBFQdWmmUMfI0aN2tFkcRYtReRR8Hfz2JMxg1BOe0dDKg7sgeNiFBS6kGpXopxxBHDWd9NcbgwLTAQK1s_a1QbivG9CpP3Hpf7l2ya2uPytQHg4nBtO97v6_UcC0_FfulPBlMjw0rBcyNXOLONyq5MpiOXgaTkAymgD65WimSd0fOS-Qb-rKFyn3JHrdMeeFtRe5qPcj85uoB_vn5rayZR_6NOWNgMHWbDY-dUqI6GqbFcneU3sPbf0c-LfwGAAD__24ReKw). The president gave the [signing pen to Robert F. Kennedy Jr.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuwyAURb8Gb1jmgU0yMHTxlq4drWd4JCQYIiCx8veVu3e70pWOjs7PZblgiCFdv3Ej03xeYICRD4KDWhyG-FlU54wnApIdGaGl1uI0KtXdDApvhfR-OHk3-dWiHVE51KBWJ8_WdsEctEGAEkKOUvZCTM5PCs5q1VrTyNRALrRc-nsOqd3Ix09-U-lt3rpobq09K5NfDGYG877vvV1ror0eP4P5mAzmVl7bk2NK-ZUsVX73D178g2_xwbFWrDUkbCEn7kOkylvmK_FCkbCSYzB3xbjnHmIMddJMDdcNQ_xzaP81eRv4DQAA__-jK2ZI), his nominee for Health and Human Services Secretary and son of the late senator. According to the National Archives, 97% of the JFK assassination files are currently public. Still, about 3,000 documents had never been made public, and 30,000 had been previously released with redactions. [See the public files here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LGO6yAQheGnwV0sZhgbp6C40pW7bLulRcxgk8UhAmIrb79K-m3_I33F-b5MFxtiuC9fdmNTfZpQYneScEKanA3xNVHjjGdGVg0b0EprGDqiZjV67s_Sk_XkB3BXJ0HKAQHo2g3DMMsmmLcmAQlAdUq1AL3zPeGZrlpr7gRJdqGm3N5SuNeVfXylnXM7p62JZq31UYT6J3AUOB7H0do8r2Hn0i5pFzhmLvxOAseb__mEyLYwSlRCjc-6TSU988xC_Z9XW5dH_dDZuMcRYgyl14LkstkQP0P964Pd4G8AAAD__1WLXXk). The actual timeline for full declassification and public access to the remaining documents is uncertain and will depend on the pace of review and redaction removal by relevant agencies.
## Judge Blocks Trump Birthright Citizenship Order
A federal judge in Seattle temporarily blocked President Donald Trump's executive order [limiting birthright citizenship](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGunDAQRb_GdEZ4bNZQuEhD99KmRIDHMJGxkT27aPP10Sb1a--Vjo7Or6_5a6FIaf-5nOg45Bk66GWnJJjZLxTfs2m8C4iAukGnrLZWDb0xzeH8qMxgPYSx9x6CsaCxX1WHawAdRtOQ-9A6BUYp3WvdKvXw4WFgNKu1FnthOvTEubS_MyU-MMR3fmFpt3w20R3MVxX6h4BJwHTfd5vWLeFdP7-A6cqRmLYqYKLzpL0sTDkJmLg8z0su_qRElf_P0mPA5KtcqfBRaD9YbsT0B1M96JK5eCxyy8_CMlCpLMuWFjUMQ6-a4vx1U4xUH1aYbj8Xiv8k-btoLwd_AwAA__8dXnIN) on Thursday, calling it "blatantly unconstitutional" in a 25-minute hearing. Senior U.S. District Judge John C. Coughenour, a Reagan appointee, issued a 14-day restraining order in response to a [lawsuit from four states](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGTpCAUhH8NZljwADkDgkvM5tILLZWnvDkcLMCx5n791kyw2SYddFd1dX9_b-NtokiP7c-0o6trGkGA4UJy0KOfKL5G3Xi3IgKqBp20ylr5y2jdBIdamN50C1gPMwrU2uu-75TsxGKshYbcu01I0FIqo1QrZefXTkOvZ2stGqYFeqopt_dEjxpwja_0xNwuaW-iC7UehanfDAYGw3VdbcazYi7v_O2kHD2D4Swf4ffTb8gDTpmXOlUsfCbP55iWf7zmcz_4TLmGTFuofKFK__FRAh08ZY-Zf19XDIYmO39cFCOVzjIttn2i-NlVf-L0dPAVAAD__5bpabs)—Washington, Arizona, Illinois, and Oregon—that argued Trump's policy violates the 14th Amendment. The Justice Department defended the order as part of Trump's effort to address border issues but promised to "vigorously defend" it as the case likely heads to the Supreme Court. The United States is one of about 30 countries that grant unconditional birthright citizenship, a policy most common in North and South America. [See the map here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvwyAQRn-NvRHBASEZGLpkS9eOFjFncy0BC19iub--SoduXT99ek96H9fhGihTmd_DHT1PdQAJVkglwAwxUN4H00c_IQLqHr1y2jl1ssb0yZ_s2UZpgotyCjGclXWj1reTAtDonOzJv2hSgVFKW60PSh3jdDRwNjfnHNrOSIzEtR0-KxVOOOW9PrEdxnrvs0_My9rptw4uHVy22nJc6vLIgamWhk_C7fXs4DLWR-G2ixbKF5V5_ZsIV7ERJ3GjxqnRnFiMxPSNZU209M3HZaOcaT26zsj5Hij_2vm_Gk8PPwEAAP__dBdkhw).
## Fires Still Rage in Southern California
Drought conditions and strong winds continue to fuel multiple wildfires in Southern California that have killed at least 28 people and [burned at least 45 square miles](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LFurDAQheGnMR2IGQ94KVxc6Ypu00RRSmTwGCby4hV2Fu3bR5s-9ZE-Hf2f1-nqJMq-vrkb2xLShC12dQs10uSdxOdElbeBGVlXbMFoY-DSEVWbpXlGQ4hLP1wAZuoNE84YNAweA_pK7EtrAQlAd1o3AL0PPeFAszGGO0UteynpaL6S7GXjEJ_pwUezpFsV7VbKPSv9T-GocHTzsvOZmzW9ZoXjx7vCMcqD6--7d4WzwnFxUUI6dnH1KdEHOTjXMeXa7StHzvXJrmx8vEg9ilf6P4DpQXcDVYf191NilNwbRe16cxJ_r5S_0jws_gQAAP__6WFkCw) of densely populated areas of Los Angeles County. New fires emerged on Wednesday and Thursday as two of the largest, the Palisades Fire in Pacific Palisades and the Eaton Fire near Pasadena, remain active. [One of the latest](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kD-PtCAQxj8NdhoY0MGC4m3o9m2vNKwMKxeUjbBr_PYXN7nyqpni9_zJ83Wbbi6muD3-u5VMDXkCDn3LRQtq8i6mc1KNN4EISDZkBEpEoXulmsVIDDhqoBGHe5Czd-jVoL0jPnOp-b2J5nLjApQQspeyE2LwYVAwqjsiUs8UJx9r3rvvHLe6UEhnftPezXltkllqfRYm_zGwDOxxHN2ruJq9Oy-AgS017ycDu9FRruNqzBsDe8UysFxcv2Rgl9djodKGuFOb8vzh2tU9W3q7-fUrQ9SjHoXiHBnYZjf-ecSUYhmQKf5YXUyfZvWvpd4GfgIAAP__5AJn0g), the Hughes Fire in the Castaic area, has prompted evacuations and burned over 10,000 acres. The Laguna Fire, which broke out Thursday [near California State University's](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOgzAQRL_GdCDv2nihcHGNu1x7JXLwkvhkMAIniL8_kf6qecVoZjQ_t-HmY4rL49vPbMuUB5TY1hJq1EPwMZ2DroKdmJFVxRZIEUHXal09bT9R16uxBTPivdOIyhACcMc03k3rq2ivNAmoAVSrVANgwmQ09vpORNwKLTnEkrfmN8elPHlKZ37z1ox5rpJ9lrLuQn0JdALdcRzNa_clB39eBoFuL3k7BbqFj_0SX2JeBLqrVqCTcLES6JJ_vBZfT3Hj-ogpfGD2q0BH1EsyoKUkga7abFiPmFLcDQktH7OP6TOn_HfP2-JfAAAA__9sdGKa) Channel Islands campus in Camarillo, grew from three to 50 acres before firefighters were able to contain it. Critical fire conditions and red-flag warnings are in effect as [Santa Ana winds](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO8yAQhJ8Gd1iA1-F3QfE37nLtldbaLPHeERMBCcrbn3z9laMZjT59n9flihz5uH3gnVwNaTHKjFJpaWDxyPG9QOddIDI0dOS0HazV_0aAbnfrqldlQU8BcAsKVzBIgDABTUhq7Nidb0ob0HoYh6HX-uLDBcwEq7WWRgGKPNeU-6_ER90pxHd6Ue63dO-i22t9FDH8F2YWZm6t9dtaDmrl7IWZI79IPh8eK5UzogycqciSnnWnfMgNI4eUD0a5822XjQ9fZOPoz6HMXL6Fmbvs_KNxjFwuVoC63ZHjL0L9S8nLmZ8AAAD__4OdZUA) continue to generate powerful gusts throughout Los Angeles and nearby Ventura counties. Rain is expected this weekend, raising concerns about the potential for mudslides and flooding in areas affected by burn scars.

subject: America's oldest cultural institution
body:
Founded in 1800, the Library of Congress predates every other federal cultural institution in the United States — it’s so old, in fact, that it was brought into existence by the same bill that relocated the U.S. capital from Philadelphia to Washington, D.C. [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=1krv9cfc68d7fk5zqpbq3lm26h9ijnfsnbveee7jeu8vzzrwshrdeo7t01yk5eji5p2gwbjmmgarymte5fgrlyhtgnfsnzuqrtm458ibou0dphbl7rlwxifseoi83w22rchnacuyq0ietbpqha1dxh1bc&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqldh3&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

# [The Library of Congress is America's oldest cultural institution.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqldh3&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [U.S. History](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqldh3&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqldh3&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| F ounded in [1800](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqldh3&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), the Library of Congress predates every other federal cultural institution in the United States — it’s so old, in fact, that it was brought into existence by the same [bill](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqldh3&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) that relocated the U.S. capital from Philadelphia to Washington, D.C. The nation’s second President, John Adams, approved said bill, which provided $5,000 (roughly $122,000 today) for books to be used by Congress. Two years later, Thomas Jefferson made the increasingly important librarian of Congress post a presidential appointment. From those humble origins, the repository of knowledge eventually became the world’s largest library: It was home to more than 175 million items as of September 2022, with more than 10,000 added every day.
---
Given the massive size of its collection, the Library of Congress is naturally home to a number of strange and fascinating objects. Its smallest book, _Old King Cole_ , is a nursery rhyme measuring 1/25th of an inch, roughly the size of a period; its largest is a 5-by-7-foot photo book featuring images of Bhutan. In addition to books, the library houses audio materials, maps, sheet music, photographs, newspapers, presidential papers, manuscripts, and other media.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqldh3&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqldh3&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## The original library was burned down in the War of 1812.
The Library of Congress was comparatively tiny for the first 14 years of its existence, but that didn’t make it any less tragic when its collection of 3,000 books was [destroyed](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sqldh3&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) in a fire along with the Capitol building on August 24, 1814. After the conflagration, Thomas Jefferson offered his own collection of 6,487 books (then the largest personal library in the nation) as a replacement for the lost volumes. Though he didn’t do so for free — Congress paid him $23,950 — Jefferson did provide the foundation for what the library eventually became. Sadly, a second fire destroyed most of his contribution, as well as nearly two-thirds of the entire collection on Christmas Eve 1851, but the institution rose from the ashes once again.

clean_body: Founded in 1800, the Library of Congress predates every other federal cultural institution in the United States — it’s so old, in fact, that it was brought into existence by the same bill that relocated the U.S. capital from Philadelphia to Washington, D.C. | F ounded in , the Library of Congress predates every other federal cultural institution in the United States — it’s so old, in fact, that it was brought into existence by the same that relocated the U.S. capital from Philadelphia to Washington, D.C. The nation’s second President, John Adams, approved said bill, which provided $5,000 (roughly $122,000 today) for books to be used by Congress. Two years later, Thomas Jefferson made the increasingly important librarian of Congress post a presidential appointment. From those humble origins, the repository of knowledge eventually became the world’s largest library: It was home to more than 175 million items as of September 2022, with more than 10,000 added every day. Given the massive size of its collection, the Library of Congress is naturally home to a number of strange and fascinating objects. Its smallest book, Old King Cole , is a nursery rhyme measuring 1/25th of an inch, roughly the size of a period; its largest is a 5-by-7-foot photo book featuring images of Bhutan. In addition to books, the library houses audio materials, maps, sheet music, photographs, newspapers, presidential papers, manuscripts, and other media. | Thank you for supporting our advertisers! | By the Numbers | | Visitors to the Library of Congress in 2022 370,000 | | Movies in the Library of Congress’ National Film Registry 850 | Movies in the Library of Congress’ National Film Registry 850 | | Languages represented in the Library of Congress 470+ | | Permanent staff members of the Library of Congress 3,172 | Permanent staff members of the Library of Congress 3,172 | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- The original library was burned down in the War of 1812. The Library of Congress was comparatively tiny for the first 14 years of its existence, but that didn’t make it any less tragic when its collection of 3,000 books was in a fire along with the Capitol building on August 24, 1814. After the conflagration, Thomas Jefferson offered his own collection of 6,487 books (then the largest personal library in the nation) as a replacement for the lost volumes. Though he didn’t do so for free — Congress paid him $23,950 — Jefferson did provide the foundation for what the library eventually became. Sadly, a second fire destroyed most of his contribution, as well as nearly two-thirds of the entire collection on Christmas Eve 1851, but the institution rose from the ashes once again. Just when you thought things couldn’t get any weirder in California, we find out that the reason for the catastrophic failure to combat the Los Angeles County fires is due to the state’s insane Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) policies!

That’s right...

The new mission of the Los Angeles Fire Department (LAFD), according to its DEI hire, Chief Kristina Crowley, is “the creation of systemic equity and inclusion across the LAFD.”

This is UNACCEPTABLE.

The only questions that should matter when hiring or promoting within a fire department are:

_“Can you pull a grown man out of a building? Can you FIGHT a wildfire?”_

Friend, this is how California got itself into the devastating mess it’s in now, but there is hope.

And that hope comes in the form of President Donald Trump.

The promise of his return to the White House provides an opportunity for America and, yes, _even California_ to sever all ties with the DEI agenda and return to a system of meritocracy that elevates everyone according to his or her effort and ability.

Until then, we must reflect on and learn from the ongoing disaster, the magnitude of which is hard to comprehend...

27 dead.
22 missing.
150,000 displaced.
13,600 structures destroyed.
Catastrophic loss of pets and wildlife.

Friend, this is what’s at stake for our nation. We must band together to elect more America First candidates who are committed to upholding meritocracy and defending traditional American values over equity.

If we don’t, our very lives could be at stake.

**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Happy Friday,
Between Colorado's legislative session and Trump's first week in office, it's been quite the week. On Sunday, we'll be featuring a **breakdown of all Trump's executive order's** thus far, so make sure you don't miss it. Here is a summary of today's top stories:
**🏛️ Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** Eastern Plains lawmakers proposed House Bill 25-1064, aiming to [ban lab-grown meat products](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in Colorado to protect the state's ranching heritage and livestock industry. Colorado lawmakers are set to tackle the [340B drug discount program](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), which supports hospitals serving Medicaid patients, amidst growing opposition from pharmaceutical companies.
Meanwhile, Senate Democrats advanced Senate Bill 5 to overhaul Colorado’s 82-year-old [Labor Peace Act](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), despite business concerns about economic competitiveness. And lastly, a bipartisan bill may require Colorado school districts to adopt policies [regulating student cellphone use](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to minimize classroom distractions and protect mental health.
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** A complaint alleges Secretary of State Jena Griswold violated her department’s own campaign finance rules by [failing to register a gubernatorial campaign committee](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) despite active preparations. Mayor Mike Johnston reaffirmed Denver's [selective cooperation with ICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), agreeing to assist in cases involving violent criminals but maintaining protections for schools, hospitals, and churches.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** President Trump has ordered the [deployment of 10,000 troops](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to the southern border. Trump [pardoned 23 pro-life activists](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) prosecuted under the FACE Act, renewing debates about the act's enforcement and its proposed repeal in Congress. A commentary by Greg Walcher explores Elon Musk's ambitious role with [DOGE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, January 24, 2025.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|

**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Complaint alleges Secretary of State Griswold has violated her own department’s campaign finance rules](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY RMV STAFF, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Jena Griswold just can’t seem to catch a break.
After the Republican Party tattled on the secretary of state, detailing disclosure of election system passwords for months on her own website and up to within days of the general election, and after the Colorado Libertarian Party sued her for the disclosure, she has had a rough go at potentially attempting to earn her party’s nomination for governor by first announcing her candidacy as a Democrat.
The latest in a winter of missteps for the secretary of state is a campaign finance complaint claiming Griswold has violated her own department’s rules for campaign announcements.
The complaint, detailed in a Colorado Politics report, was filed Jan. 14 by The Public Trust Institute, represented by Suzanne Taheri of West Group Law, the Colorado Politics report notes. Taheri formerly served as deputy secretary under Republican Secretary of State Wayne Williams, who some Republicans previously criticized for infamously appearing in an election commercial with Griswold.

**[Eastern Plains lawmakers want to prohibit ‘cultivated’ meat in Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* House Bill 25-1064, sponsored by Representatives Ty Winter and Rod Pelton, aims to prohibit the sale, manufacture, and distribution of lab-grown meat products in Colorado, citing concerns for the state’s ranching heritage and agriculture-driven economy.
* Supporters of the bill argue that traditional livestock farming is integral to Colorado’s cultural and economic identity, emphasizing that cultivated meat is a synthetic product unsuitable for American consumption.
* While the bill highlights ranchers’ livelihoods and food authenticity, critics raise free-market concerns, noting the FDA and USDA approvals of cultivated meat for public consumption in recent years.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[10,000 troops headed to seal the southern border, as Trump shuts down asylum process](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* President Trump has ordered the deployment of 10,000 additional troops to the southern border, bolstering efforts to secure the area and implement a shutdown of the asylum process.
* The move is part of an executive order declaring the situation at the border a national emergency and aims to prevent illegal entry while prioritizing national security.
* Troops will support border agents by constructing barriers, enhancing surveillance, and assisting deportation flights for detained individuals, while maintaining a limited role in direct law enforcement.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Shamblin: President Trump pardons pro-life political prisoners for crime of peacefully protesting](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* President Trump pardoned 23 pro-life activists prosecuted under the FACE Act, a law criticized for targeting peaceful protests while ignoring violence against pro-life organizations.
* Critics, including Rep. Chip Roy, argue the FACE Act has been misused and are pushing for its repeal to prevent future crackdowns on pro-life advocacy.
* The pardons highlight ongoing debates about the balance between protecting access to clinics and ensuring First Amendment rights for pro-life advocates.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Walcher: Is government going to the DOGE?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Elon Musk and Vivek Ramaswamy are spearheading the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) to tackle federal waste and inefficiency, focusing on privatizing assets and reducing redundant programs.
* Suggestions include abolishing outdated agencies like the Bureau of Reclamation, privatizing public entities like Amtrak, and implementing sunset clauses for regulations to curb overreach.
* The initiative has sparked bipartisan interest, with thousands of citizens contributing ideas, but faces significant political hurdles as every federal program has its defenders.

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support! | House Bill 25-1064, sponsored by Representatives Ty Winter and Rod Pelton, aims to prohibit the sale, manufacture, and distribution of lab-grown meat products in Colorado, citing concerns for the state’s ranching heritage and agriculture-driven economy. Supporters of the bill argue that traditional livestock farming is integral to Colorado’s cultural and economic identity, emphasizing that cultivated meat is a synthetic product unsuitable for American consumption. While the bill highlights ranchers’ livelihoods and food authenticity, critics raise free-market concerns, noting the FDA and USDA approvals of cultivated meat for public consumption in recent years. | President Trump has ordered the deployment of 10,000 additional troops to the southern border, bolstering efforts to secure the area and implement a shutdown of the asylum process. The move is part of an executive order declaring the situation at the border a national emergency and aims to prevent illegal entry while prioritizing national security. Troops will support border agents by constructing barriers, enhancing surveillance, and assisting deportation flights for detained individuals, while maintaining a limited role in direct law enforcement. | President Trump pardoned 23 pro-life activists prosecuted under the FACE Act, a law criticized for targeting peaceful protests while ignoring violence against pro-life organizations. Critics, including Rep. Chip Roy, argue the FACE Act has been misused and are pushing for its repeal to prevent future crackdowns on pro-life advocacy. The pardons highlight ongoing debates about the balance between protecting access to clinics and ensuring First Amendment rights for pro-life advocates. | Elon Musk and Vivek Ramaswamy are spearheading the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) to tackle federal waste and inefficiency, focusing on privatizing assets and reducing redundant programs. Suggestions include abolishing outdated agencies like the Bureau of Reclamation, privatizing public entities like Amtrak, and implementing sunset clauses for regulations to curb overreach. The initiative has sparked bipartisan interest, with thousands of citizens contributing ideas, but faces significant political hurdles as every federal program has its defenders. | ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | JANUARY 23 Genuine confidence can sometimes feel like a rare gem in a world filled with pride and arrogance. #
Friend of Life,

As you've most likely seen, parts of beautiful Southern California are being destroyed by ruthless flames.

My family and I are safe, but many are not. As we pray for the protection of all those in the fire's path, there is something else you can do to help these victims.

Live Action is partnering with EveryLife to send diapers to families impacted by the fires. From now through the end of the month, every gift of $50, using this link, will enable a box of diapers (6 packs!) to be sent to a family in critical need. Will you step up now for these families? [ ](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/h7DrIOIYbDxW0GnEFnEzNA~~/AARclAA~/RgRpdiUoP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9naXZlLmxpdmVhY3Rpb24ub3JnL2NhLXdpbGRmaXJlcy1kaWFwZXItZHJpdmUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9cHJvc3BlY3RpbmcmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249ZGlhcGVyX3BhY2smdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9bGlsYV9BRS1ST042MDg5NFcDc3BjQgpnjniMk2futkcCUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

Over 130,000 have been evacuated so far and many are struggling to meet basic needs, unsure what they'll be returning to after the flames subside.

In these stressful moments, practical necessities make all the difference, especially when babies are involved. That's why we're partnering with EveryLife to provide diapers to families in need.

EveryLife is coordinating with CityServe and Convoy of Hope, working tirelessly to ensure the diapers reach California families in need by any means necessary.

This means all you need to do is fill out the donation form with a gift of $50 or more, and the rest will be taken care of for you.

**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's [hear.com's](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6031fb318a1c432cb118dd2035300725&_e=oojv0iyjfRAjxw4ywRo-KVD423OUPabfTEoRvbTmgVc1xoClQ_HNEG5psIJS80TvYSGHPDVAZCPPgnRdHzwn1dAlq36AQ0QG8FPqOFdxLKOPZ_3XSFgaT0AVhFFIARrgvjEU77dVx8cI2xcQ7k8ila6GI3-PTtFeVuNjbCwpQZ3o2KPYXZZ3-q4QFrb4SJA1KSrroaYkTzWvHDxjxGwgs-idrG9TuiG6OTNg8CKhIS0e6iLKfLd_dQtLRMFy0JPaIRTjdh6t4-gMdkLNarm7p86PwFDohL3UM8TAQRF9dM6qqAii5lfywo5M6vuY-ueSSyV8wucrmWXg-YrZdFQU_RCne2UccKiOsfDI90RrAvqd2ARclZFxuwfdBsKQm4AKWWR3997nm2bLb2EkrLy2AzBekB9PFlJXgs3FZA91aDWh1E2iUlKPCHf5iyvLxg-946lfJt7yIA7jf6Vwd_Ay72ovvPkleLKL0rm7I8KTDZQ%3D) **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

As you've most likely seen, parts of beautiful Southern California are being destroyed by ruthless flames.

My family and I are safe, but many are not. As we pray for the protection of all those in the fire's path, there is something else you can do to help these victims.

Live Action is partnering with EveryLife to send diapers to families impacted by the fires. From now through the end of the month, every gift of $50, using this link, will enable a box of diapers (6 packs!) to be sent to a family in critical need. Will you step up now for these families? In these stressful moments, practical necessities make all the difference, especially when babies are involved. That's why we're partnering with EveryLife to provide diapers to families in need.

body:
Fellow activist,

The New PA Project Education Fund is dedicated to ensuring full participation in the democratic process through civic education and year-round voter engagement by centering Black, Indigenous, and other people of color, immigrant communities and the youth - with intention - as they are the least represented and most impacted by decisions our government is making.

As we prepare for our programmatic work in 2025, it’s critical that we hear what issues folks care most about. These responses will impact our civic education and engagement efforts across the Commonwealth. And as a dedicated supporter of NPPEF, we’d love to get your input!

Please take the time to fill out our survey: What issues do YOU care about the most in 2025?

Your input today will help inform our strategies as we near this year’s critical local, municipal, and judicial elections.

Thank you,

Team NPPEF

NPPEF ensures full participation in the democratic process through civic education and year-round engagement by centering Black, Indigenous, and other people of color, immigrant communities and the youth - with intention - as they are the least represented and most impacted by decisions our government is making.

Sen. Markwayne Mullin **[put CNN's Erin Burnett in her place](https://substack.com/redirect/c1be4a0a-5962-44ba-96a9-96db223b2373?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after she asked him a very personal question about his experience during January 6.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/c1be4a0a-5962-44ba-96a9-96db223b2373?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"You were there!" Burnett told Mullin. "You say it was a riot, you barricaded the door! How can you defend people like that?!!"
**[Mullin refused to take the bait,](https://substack.com/redirect/c1be4a0a-5962-44ba-96a9-96db223b2373?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** giving a strong and measured response.
"I am not trying to defend the individuals whatsoever,... I'm saying things change when President Biden did what he did, and both are equally bad!" Mullin explained.
"No one should be assaulting police officers ESPECIALLY those that Biden pardoned who killed officers!" he added.

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for re-election so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in the United States Senate. The Radical Left has him circled as a prime target to defeat in the 2026 Midterm Elections. Can he count on your support? _

Thank you, Coach Tuberville Meet Coach Tuberville: Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces. In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud. In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson. In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others. In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime. Now, Coach Tuberville is running for re-election so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in the United States Senate. The Radical Left has him circled as a prime target to defeat in the 2026 Midterm Elections. Can he count on your support? name: Gabby Giffords
subject: I launched my first campaign for Congress 19 years ago today
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Nineteen years ago, founding GIFFORDS and dedicating my life’s work to gun violence prevention wasn’t a part of my plan. But I’m happy that my life journey brought me here.
#

Friends -
On this day 19 years ago, I launched my first campaign for Congress.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-jan25.MP3Bzo&refcode=em250124-1-b&t=1&akid=9880%2E3935704%2EwGC1wR)
I remember how much hope I was filled with on January 24, 2006. I was determined to be a young, new voice in Congress that could help bridge the partisan divide in Washington.
I won my first Congressional campaign. And my second. And my third. In every race, I overcame tough political odds to deliver for Arizonans. People called me a rising star. But on that day, I never could have imagined that my political career would be cut short.
After a gunman filled with hate tried to assassinate me on January 8, 2011, my life changed forever. In order to focus on my recovery, I had to resign from Congress on January 25, 2012--almost exactly six years to the day after I launched my first Congressional campaign.
Nineteen years ago, founding GIFFORDS and dedicating my life’s work to gun violence prevention wasn’t a part of my plan. But I’m happy that my life journey brought me here.
I am so proud to wake up and fight for safer communities alongside you each and every day. While the times we’re currently facing are challenging, I am fiercely determined to bring the same hope I felt on January 24, 2006 to the work we do here at GIFFORDS each and every day. Because when we have collective hope, a better future is possible.
Thank you for taking the time to read my story today. If you’re able, I hope you’ll consider [**making a donation to GIFFORDS PAC**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-jan25.MP3Bzo&refcode=em250124-1-b&t=2&akid=9880%2E3935704%2EwGC1wR) to recommit yourself to the movement to save lives from gun violence.
My very best,
Gabby Giffords

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=4&akid=9880%2E3935704%2EwGC1wR) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

| **Meet Jim:** Congressman Jim Baird is a decorated Vietnam War Veteran and the proud representative for Indiana's 4th Congressional District in our nation's capital. A lifelong resident of West Central Indiana, Jim grew up on his family's farm and had the values of faith, family, and hard work instilled in him at an early age. He is an unwavering defender of America's Constitutional liberties and has spent the vast majority of his life serving our country. After earning both his bachelor's and his master's at Purdue University, Jim was assigned to the 523rd Transportation Company at Cha Rang Valley in Vietnam. He fought in two of the deadliest battles of Operation Lam Son 719 and lost his left arm during a convoy ambush in March of 1971. In a true embodiment of American sacrifice and patriotism, Jim Baird has put his life on the line time and time again fighting communism abroad. His belief in the American Dream and our American way of life go far beyond words. For the entirety of his life, Jim has fought the good fight for our country both physically and spiritually. And he wears his love for the world's greatest country on his sleeve each and every day that he shows up for work in Washington, D.C. Previously, Jim Baird spent eight years in the Indiana House of Representatives serving District 44 from 2010 to 2018. Prior to that, he was Putnam County Commissioner from 2006 to 2010. A fiscal conservative and America First Republican, Jim is incredibly proud to fight every day in DC to advance the best interests of Indiana's families through Congress. A loving husband to his wife Danise, a devoted father to his children, and the world's best pop-pop to his grandkids, Jim spends most of his free time in the company of his loved ones or tending to the family farm.

body:
I need just a few minutes of your time

|
---

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/100895005/524270924/-317235110?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_NomineesTK_250124_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MGQ4OWMyNi02YWRhLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk1NzkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uJ5CooEvZhFK9AG11Kjyd4k02fy9TkM7FPGMHFxRhlQ=) Derek,

Last week, I questioned Pete Hegseth, Donald Trump’s defense secretary pick, at his confirmation hearing.

This email isn’t about the multiple allegations of wildly inappropriate behavior by Hegseth — from abuse of women, to serial infidelity, to fiscal mismanagement, to working while under the influence of alcohol. It’s about my concern that he, and many of Trump’s other nominees, can’t be trusted to be honest with the American people. And more than that, it’s about how incredibly important these hearings are.

These are incredibly serious jobs. In turn, it's our job as committee members — and as representatives of the American people — to bring the truth to light before the Senate votes.

[_**Which brings me to my friend Mark. Mark has been taking the reins at other key confirmation hearings — and I want to ask you a favor: He’s on the ballot in 2026, and I want to let him know we have his back today. Can you donate $5 to his campaign right now?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/100895006/524270925/-317235110?amount=5&refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_NomineesTK_250124_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MGQ4OWMyNi02YWRhLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk1NzkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uJ5CooEvZhFK9AG11Kjyd4k02fy9TkM7FPGMHFxRhlQ=)

52 years ago in January 1973, the Supreme Court INCORRECTLY enshrined abortion as a "right."
For decades, this had served as a somber reminder of the fight to protect the unborn.
And almost 50 years later, via the Dobbs Decision, a new Supreme Court overturned Roe delivering a massive victory for LIFE. With the fight for life battle now moved to the States, there are still issues that we must handle here at the federal level like defunding Planned Parenthood.
And as President Trump and Elon Musk look for areas to cut the federal budget, I can think of no better place to start than cutting all federal funding from Planned Parenthood. **[Please sign the petition if you believe that Planned Parenthood should be cut from federal funding.](https://r2.ddlnk.net/c/AQj9jBYQpN0BGIy40Agg580qrD1NeWu-oQ6QhOHdGbkbPcSpIuB1fLX2IaGtJ6M8ykQ) **

Every dollar sent to Planned Parenthood funds an organization that has profited off the loss of innocent lives. As we work to build a culture of life, we must ensure that our tax dollars no longer support such practices.

Your voice is critical in this fight. By signing the petition, you’re joining thousands of others who believe in defending the unborn and standing against the misuse of taxpayer dollars.
