| **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
Contact: Roberto Nava
Email: roberto@solidaritystrategies.com
Phone: 787-366-6013 **RootsCamp 2025: The Premier Gathering for Progressive Action**
**New Dates: February 6-8, 2025 | Maritime Conference Center, MD** **Washington, DC** — This week has been challenging for many, but don’t let the media narrative fool you. Across the progressive movement, people are working quietly yet powerfully to resist and combat harmful policies. Momentum is building for the change we need—and _RootsCamp 2025_ is the platform where it all comes together. With just two weeks until RootsCamp (February 6–8, 2025, at the Maritime Conference Center near Baltimore), excitement is growing. Over **400 participants** from more than **120 organizations** have already signed up as sponsors, partners, volunteers, session leaders, and attendees. RootsCamp is shaping up to be the nation’s premier gathering for progressive strategists, organizers, and movement leaders. However, we need your help to make this event accessible for all. Many of our most dedicated colleagues are facing financial challenges due to post-election layoffs and the end of the Biden administration. To ensure no one is left out, we’re raising **$150,000** in the next two weeks to provide scholarships and travel stipends for those unable to afford attendance. **🔗 Here’s how you can help right now:**
* **Donate to the Scholarship Fund:**[ ](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=b9b9d31f2d&e=b8f90417f9)rootscamp.link/scholarship-fund
* **Register for RootsCamp:** [rootscamp.link/register](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=c58b2ba859&e=b8f90417f9)
* **Sponsor or Partner with RootsCamp:** [rootscamp.link/partnersignup](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=66d3a2fda8&e=b8f90417f9)

**Why RootsCamp Matters** RootsCamp 2025 is more than just an event—it’s the progressive movement’s proving ground. With **over 50 progressive organizations** , including America Votes, SEIU, and Movement Voter Project, joining forces with grassroots groups and individual organizers, this is where the future of advocacy, elections, and democracy will take shape. Participants can expect:
* **Dynamic Sessions:** Dozens of sessions on organizing, messaging, mobilization, and professional development.
* **Community Connections:** Opportunities to strategize with the most influential voices in the progressive movement.
* **Marquee Speakers & Panels:** Hear from inspiring leaders and visionaries.
* **Career Fair & Marketplace:** Connect with organizations and explore new opportunities.

**A Snapshot of RootsCamp 2025** **Sponsors:** America Votes, SEIU, NGP VAN, Color of Change, Berlin Rosen, and more.
**Partners:** Indivisible Common Ground WNC, Movement Voter Fund, Resilient Strategies AZ, Swing Left, VoteAmerica, and others.
**Attendees:** Greenpeace, Working Families Party, Advocacy Atlas, SEIU, and over 100 additional groups. RootsCamp is where we’ll debrief the 2024 election cycle, celebrate wins, analyze setbacks, and prepare for the challenges ahead. It’s a collaborative space that ensures everyone—regardless of financial barriers—can participate in building a better future. **🚀 Ready to join us?**
* **Donate now:** [rootscamp.link/scholarship-fund](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=ccde1378c4&e=b8f90417f9)
* **Learn more about RootsCamp:** [www.rootscamp.com](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=84f6a21d7e&e=b8f90417f9)

**Media Access** Journalists are invited to attend and report on the discussions and connections forged at RootsCamp 2025. Media can register for credentials and request interviews with event organizers, speakers, and participants. For more information, contact Roberto Nava at **roberto@solidaritystrategies.com**. Join us as we resist, persist, and organize for a brighter future. See you at RootsCamp 2025!

AP: Trump’s new Justice Department leadership orders a freeze on civil rights cases [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=012425_1&amount=25]
Even if we knew this was coming, Team, it's still bad: The Justice Department has ordered the civil rights division to halt much of its investigative activity and not pursue new indictments, cases or settlements , according to a memo sent to the temporary head of the division.
The letter instructs the division to ensure that civil rights attorneys do not file “ any new complaints, motions to intervene, agreed-upon remands, amicus briefs, or statements of interest. ” Another memo directed attorneys to notify leadership of any settlements or consent decrees — court-enforceable agreements to reform police agencies — that were finalized by the Biden administration within the last 90 days.
It's worth noting that these memos pertain to the work done by nonpartisan civil servants, lawyers who are career DOJ employees and serve regardless of who is president. Any presidential appointees from the last administration ended their jobs when Trump was inaugurated.
This action -- though expected, based on how this division was sidelined in Trump's first four years -- highlights how badly we need to fight for our fundamental rights as citizens , from the outside of government.
Will you chip in $25 or whatever you can today to help us defend the right to vote across the country, from state legislatures to courtrooms to the ballot box? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=012425_1&amount=25]

| We can’t lose momentum now, Peter.

Right now, Republicans have control of the House, the Senate, and the presidency, and we’re bracing ourselves as the incoming administration attempts to dismantle our democratic institutions.

body:
So, they created Saving the Easter Bunny, a brand-new children's book that's destined to be a classic.| | | Brave Books is spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" revival campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate...
---
| |
---
| | Dear Fellow Believer, It may seem a little early to be talking about Easter, but it's really only about 12 weeks away.And in that short amount of time, my friends at Brave Books are spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate......to Jesus.And this revival mission needs you! My friend, if you've seen me talking about Brave Books on Fox News, you know their mission is to counter the ungodly lies being pushed by the Left in schools, libraries, and Hollywood......by creating high-quality, wholesome, and Godly books and entertainment that instill conservative values and Gospel lessons in our children. And their "Prepare the Way" revival campaign is their biggest effort yet to point parents and children to the empty tomb and God’s redeeming love.Here’s exactly what their strategy is...First... Brave Books knows that families need an easy and impactful way to counter the Left's secularization of Easter and instead, captivate children with its true meaning. So, they created _Saving the Easter Bunny_ , a brand-new children's book that's destined to be a classic.In it, Ronnie the Rabbit learns the hard way what sin is and that our Lord Jesus Christ loves us so much that he took the punishment for that sin.Jesus is represented by a powerful lion named Lord Joshua and the book beautifully portrays his resurrection and God's never-ending redeeming love for us. It's incredible.And let me tell you, parents are hungry for content like this because everywhere they turn godlessness is being pushed by schools, left-wing publishers like Scholastic, and Hollywood. When Brave Books first introduced a God-centered Christmas game called "_Mouse in the House_ ," to counter the secular elf game that has become so popular -- it sold out in THREE HOURS!That's why step one of Brave Books' 12-week "Prepare the Way" revival, is ramping up the printing and distribution of _Saving the Easter Bunny_ big-time. **[And today I'm hoping you'll help them kick it into high gear before orders start pouring in by rushing back your best "Prepare the Way" gift.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=d8c8c4e39dc642a996ce2b6c3d55441e&_e=P2I_x0Y852jxndbgX-xCrNrrob7Sa13Cl183NwZYoLJH4yO4SaIw4DIcOV95J2DnJomtKeOV0Uvzah-66tcxy4oF6zpW0cJm9HUsGar5r0U4NQFqBGCg8znFCd75vl2K4HmFluwH8qvqqte2CweVhmJ8l_A-PXd3jF1WoKw0LMZcVYd1FHbbOk4H73qJbLJvIqk-nWff3__foQvxpL7rKRMXcVcuS-1jeQzejiQ7JE2_QFxrD6tKkI_tyCA6ZcnktRQcsnIc1PPeLvMUkIiFDf74e5CQzwYsPtV6Ykf4ABTSm1mGk3lSlAPXLE1V0DU4XeF4_ORi72uhmcJyXpeUcBl4-wfEeQ-mOgRHZqdMC2ylrLvJo0amvR161pBxk0F_)** No family should go without this wonderful book because of overwhelming demand. Second... Recognizing that families who want to raise their children with wholesome Christian values often feel alone in their mission...Brave Books is launching a 17-city traveling church tour that starts in Ponta Vedra Beach, Florida and ends in Laurel, Mississippi. I'll be leading the tour in every city as we prepare our hearts and our families for Easter through prayer, worship, music, and just some good old-fashioned conversation about raising Godly children in our godless culture.Our church tour aims to ignite a spirit of revival in thousands of families this Easter season and I can't wait to see what God makes of that! But getting our worship teams, musicians, and all the rest to 17 different cities for thousands of families to enjoy won't be easy and it won't be inexpensive.But I know we can do it.Brave Books is a small Christian company founded by a doctor named Trent Talbot. After having his first child, he saw how the Left was using books and entertainment to turn the hearts and minds of America's children away from God. And so he decided to take action and with the help of believers just like you, look at what they've already done:
---
>>> They've countered the Left's radical and ungodly "Drag Queen Story Hours" and filled children's hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God with their highly-publicized "See You at the Library" campaign. Armed with Brave Books' "See You at the Library" kits, thousands of parents, grandparents, children, and concerned citizens have gathered at over 360 libraries in 49 states to take back our libraries.>>> Created an historic TV show called "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" to fight the ungodly lessons coming out of Hollywood. It's our modern day "Mr. Rogers' Neighborhood" funded by everyday Americans who want to return American culture to God. "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" uses humor and storytelling to reinforce the traditional biblical values that have made America great.>>> And now you are crucial to the success and failure of our "Prepare the Way" revival campaign which features the printing and distribution of _Saving the Easter Bunny_ and a 17-city church tour.
---
Just look at what parents have already said about S _aving the Easter Bunny_ :
---
"It's not easy to explain the true meaning of Easter to adults never mind to children, but Brave Books does it beautifully."
---
— Lisa A.
---
"My kids love the amazing illustrations and so do I!"
---
– Bob A.
---
"My three granddaughters barely sit still but when I'm reading this book and Lord Joshua dies, you can hear a pin drop. That's quickly replaced by squeals of joy after the resurrection. Thank you for bringing the joy of Easter to their little hearts."
---
– Laurin
---

But nothing Brave Books accomplishes is possible without you. And if you need one more reason to help, when you **[contribute $100 or more to the "Prepare the Way" revival](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=d8c8c4e39dc642a996ce2b6c3d55441e&_e=P2I_x0Y852jxndbgX-xCrNrrob7Sa13Cl183NwZYoLJH4yO4SaIw4DIcOV95J2DnJomtKeOV0Uvzah-66tcxy4oF6zpW0cJm9HUsGar5r0U4NQFqBGCg8znFCd75vl2K4HmFluwH8qvqqte2CweVhmJ8l_A-PXd3jF1WoKw0LMZcVYd1FHbbOk4H73qJbLJvIqk-nWff3__foQvxpL7rKRMXcVcuS-1jeQzejiQ7JE2QoJcW1PqneY7F4uSa5tC3nwg3y2Vg45L-ZbYJRyDtX0-JJrRvZKKCj9WTejG7KrgdUMg6wfXvRuGgbueTw8LCTq2NXNKE7mumbdJtj_PAbBZHprY9DsNgDwoV2Fn9P3vEV9nFRGzQqdxEBZssuXLB)** , Brave Books will send you _Saving the Easter Bunny_ absolutely free as a thank you. You can keep _Saving the Easter Bunny_ for your family, gift it to someone you love, or you can donate it to your favorite charity in the hopes of reaching a family who doesn't have a Christian role model in their life. **[**What's most important is that you rush back your best "Prepare the Way" gift of $35, $50, $100, or more right away.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=d8c8c4e39dc642a996ce2b6c3d55441e&_e=P2I_x0Y852jxndbgX-xCrNrrob7Sa13Cl183NwZYoLJH4yO4SaIw4DIcOV95J2DnJomtKeOV0Uvzah-66tcxy4oF6zpW0cJm9HUsGar5r0U4NQFqBGCg8znFCd75vl2K4HmFluwH8qvqqte2CweVhmJ8l_A-PXd3jF1WoKw0LMZcVYd1FHbbOk4H73qJbLJvIqk-nWff3__foQvxpL7rKRMXcVcuS-1jeQzejiQ7JE33Ivmsz_VCUGS_xwc-gYFpPEzj6SBqJkc2TZgbPqqCBG1KwOSaIxIQ6jG7kHFZSDGAv3fOCtaXH221WEiuaHKn0mMaiDd7hoN98KPxbQYM6coqqGSDA3TnbUymaLQL31gWDloc-WTaQPNQ_SV2oNeK)** Thank you for bringing the true meaning of Easter to families all across America.

May God bless you this coming Easter season,

"Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" uses humor and storytelling to reinforce the traditional biblical values that have made America great.>>> And now you are crucial to the success and failure of our "Prepare the Way" revival campaign which features the printing and distribution of Saving the Easter Bunny and a 17-city church tour. | | We're coming to the end of Trump's first week as president, and it's been full of dangerous and destructive executive orders and ominous promises that will hurt Americans. In just his first week, Trump signed executive orders that:
* Pardons many of the January 6 rioters who violently sought to overturn a free and fair election
* Withdrew from the Paris Climate Agreement and the World Health Organization
* Revokes the Constitutional right of birthright citizenship, which was just blocked in court
* Reverses several Biden administration executive orders on health care, including efforts to lower the cost of prescription drugs for people on Medicare and Medicaid, enhancing the Affordable Care Act, and increasing protections for Medicaid enrollees

And there are many more that will create chaos and confusion for the American people. **Right now, we have a choice:** between allowing corruption to thrive or combatting it, between handing out favors to corporations and special interests or providing opportunities for working families, and between being weak and alone or strong and leading the world into the rest of this century. **Our job isn't to score political points, but to make sure that the change we make brings a new status quo that works for everyone.** I'm ready to get to work on the real issues that matter most, and I hope Trump and the entire Republican party starts working for the people. Right now, we have a choice: between allowing corruption to thrive or combatting it, between handing out favors to corporations and special interests or providing opportunities for working families, and between being weak and alone or strong and leading the world into the rest of this century. Foreign adversaries and bad actors thrive on spreading lies to erode public trust in our democracy. For many years, across presidential administrations, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) has been an essential partner in this fight. They’ve provided intelligence briefings to Secretaries of State, issued public warnings about disinformation campaigns, and helped safeguard our election infrastructure. _Now, that critical support is at risk._ During her confirmation hearings to lead the Department of Homeland Security, Governor Kristi Noem suggested that DHS should no longer be in the business of combatting election disinformation, calling that work “mission drift.” **Let me be clear: this isn’t just a dangerous shift in priorities—it’s a surrender to those who want to poison our democracy with lies and confusion.** If confirmed, Noem’s vision could embolden those who spread disinformation, leaving our elections more vulnerable than ever before. [**Team, I need your help to fight back. We need to raise $10,000 this week to ensure we have the resources to push back against this dangerous rhetoric and to continue our work combatting election disinformation. Dear Peter,

Yesterday, President Trump pardoned 23 individuals convicted under the Freedom of Access to Clinic Entrances (FACE) Act—individuals whose actions threatened, harassed, and harmed abortion patients, providers, and clinics. [**These pardons are effectively a mandate to attack abortion clinics, providers and their patients, including Center clients.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100900895/524286144/2141984067?sourceid=1150338&utm_campaign=25emrfd-0101aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=renewals&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZTZjOWE1OS03MmRhLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk1NzkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NB6n7eUrX-OVkztMPulLmqX0XoHWLIyaWCa4tMbjnrQ=&emci=987bff57-ded9-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&emdi=ee6c9a59-72da-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&ceid=954237) | [**PROTECT ABORTION ACCESS**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100900896/524286145/2141984067?sourceid=1150338&utm_campaign=25emrfd-0101aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=renewals&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZTZjOWE1OS03MmRhLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk1NzkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NB6n7eUrX-OVkztMPulLmqX0XoHWLIyaWCa4tMbjnrQ=&emci=987bff57-ded9-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&emdi=ee6c9a59-72da-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&ceid=954237 "PROTECT ABORTION ACCESS")

"President Trump's pardons are a get-out-of-jail-free card inviting anti-abortion extremists to step up their attacks on reproductive health clinics with impunity. Congress enacted the FACE Act over 30 years ago with strong bi-partisan support because patients, clinic staff, and doctors needed protection from a reign of terror that included murders, arson, vandalism and clinic blockades," said Nancy Northup, President and CEO of the Center for Reproductive Rights.
[**PROTECT ABORTION ACCESS**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100900897/524286146/2141984067?sourceid=1150338&utm_campaign=25emrfd-0101aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=renewals&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZTZjOWE1OS03MmRhLWVmMTEtODhmOC0wMDIyNDgyYTk1NzkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NB6n7eUrX-OVkztMPulLmqX0XoHWLIyaWCa4tMbjnrQ=&emci=987bff57-ded9-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&emdi=ee6c9a59-72da-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579&ceid=954237 "PROTECT ABORTION ACCESS")
---
Enforcement of the FACE Act is needed now more than ever: Since _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned in 2022, there's been a sharp increase in violence against abortion clinics, staff and patients.

Congress enacted the FACE Act over 30 years ago with strong bi-partisan support because patients, clinic staff, and doctors needed protection from a reign of terror that included murders, arson, vandalism and clinic blockades," said Nancy Northup, President and CEO of the Center for Reproductive Rights. "PROTECT ABORTION ACCESS" Enforcement of the FACE Act is needed now more than ever: Since Roe v. Wade was overturned in 2022, there's been a sharp increase in violence against abortion clinics, staff and patients. At the Center, we represent clients directly impacted by these attacks. With these pardons, the administration is dismantling critical protections, releasing convicted extremists to continue their harrassment, and fueling a campaign of fear against anyone seeking or providing reproductive care. It’s important you download your concealed carry certificate before it's banned for good.

Due to increased pressure from lawmakers, a website offering you a certificate for America’s Top CCW Gun Permit **could be shut down at any moment.**

Which is why it’s important you download your **Concealed Carry Certificate ASAP**.

Wait even one more day and we won’t be able to guarantee this certificate will be available to download.

This certificate is great for gun owners because it takes advantage of a little-known (but 100% legal) loophole - **[allowing you to get a CCW certification from this website](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/19994/6374453/b0441ecabca460ba1299c9aaf4ae8f86d94e17d6/0b189cf7b526429040e7c93739b4c3da26050eb5). This loophole ensures you encounter:

* Zero gun range time (you don’t even need to fire a gun to get this permit).

**[It’s as simple as visiting this site and answering a few questions (they’re simple)](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/19994/6374453/b0441ecabca460ba1299c9aaf4ae8f86d94e17d6/0b189cf7b526429040e7c93739b4c3da26050eb5).**

Plus you can complete the entire certification process online.

Download it directly to your phone or computer in as little as 30 minutes.

**You don’t even need to own a gun to get this permit...** that’s why it’s named America’s #1 Concealed Carry Permit.

31 states have agreed to accept this permit so far. That’s because it’s simply the closest and easiest path to a semi-nationally recognized permit that’s available right now.

This permit isn’t just a basic concealed carry permit either. **It’s one of a kind... and is available to you No Matter what state you reside in.**

**Hurry and get it now.**

**[There are no guarantees this website](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/19994/6374453/b0441ecabca460ba1299c9aaf4ae8f86d94e17d6/0b189cf7b526429040e7c93739b4c3da26050eb5)** will be able to legally deliver this certificate to your email address after today!

#
Friend of Life,

As you've most likely seen, parts of beautiful Southern California are being destroyed by ruthless flames.

My family and I are safe, but many are not. As we pray for the protection of all those in the fire's path, there is something else you can do to help these victims.

Live Action is partnering with EveryLife to send diapers to families impacted by the fires. From now through the end of the month, every gift of $50, using this link, will enable a box of diapers (6 packs!) to be sent to a family in critical need. Will you step up now for these families? [ ](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=18c21666a05a40d38353915c2d4f9fbc&_e=EawA-qPrF9EJ8HX9EMtZBfNzoRDHVF_laVqRFEfOYe5tlkFpqISqxpkHM2G9MBYPWJ9BDv_4FwBIjZSJgl7ILZpNGRxIjglrbTgUqd65tnHVuxVTJ1NGKivM-YBmHLuKvAkf373HmfEN4LBKkA9vZFkMYIvRWtT7af6GZ9q5_ZHL_43U-5G2luCI6nyaoL-KIuBkZ-8nA7-UN-xxsbDIXYiMrYE5euhD9PHDLJ0RDJ9MuyObm-7zAEr05tFLZf3o5Qn24N17VLJPHk7AE8mfYZKDRpKCkv-0bww-al99QoA1C3LCLO6rWfzRXXdSTlqWuAVOZv2jmLKgMgAv7tyhMHS2A4idJbZahjgZJ9MFGU5QRveVR1P9T3txgDkQK0ky)
With 5 already dead and over 2,000 buildings destroyed, news reports are saying this is one of the most destructive fires in recorded history for this region of California.

Over 130,000 have been evacuated so far and many are struggling to meet basic needs, unsure what they'll be returning to after the flames subside.

In these stressful moments, practical necessities make all the difference, especially when babies are involved. That's why we're partnering with EveryLife to provide diapers to families in need.

EveryLife is coordinating with CityServe and Convoy of Hope, working tirelessly to ensure the diapers reach California families in need by any means necessary.

This means all you need to do is fill out the donation form with a gift of $50 or more, and the rest will be taken care of for you.

Send a box containing 6 packs of diapers to a family in need: **[https://give.liveaction.org/ca-wildfires-diaper-drive/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=18c21666a05a40d38353915c2d4f9fbc&_e=EawA-qPrF9EJ8HX9EMtZBfNzoRDHVF_laVqRFEfOYe5tlkFpqISqxpkHM2G9MBYPWJ9BDv_4FwBIjZSJgl7ILZpNGRxIjglrbTgUqd65tnHVuxVTJ1NGKivM-YBmHLuKvAkf373HmfEN4LBKkA9vZFkMYIvRWtT7af6GZ9q5_ZHL_43U-5G2luCI6nyaoL-KIuBkZ-8nA7-UN-xxsbDIXb7IDNdpKUwORcgpSrCjpVq0R3xrpnz_TtLKpiEzx6nsJrEQqvBefb9R9u5px2XGfZoV_r_TxtsMi1eE7ucx9RHVcLuH03iUK1jVts3X2re2eh5GG_m0kHowFWqG0vXvptb0r38SvnMMuSPvNOfDSk1XjtpD7MYXODfDnAPI89aE)**

Thank you for standing with us to help children and families affected during this critical time.

For Life,

Lila Rose
**Founder and President**

#
---
Team, In 2024, we came together, rolled up our sleeves, and delivered for Michiganders. We’ve led the way in making Michigan the best place to live and raise a family. We’ve worked to... 1) Fix our roads
2) Replace pipes
3) Build housing
4) Feed students in our schools
5) Hire more first responders
6) Protect our fundamental freedoms
7) Lower costs for working families
8) Make our communities safer

Friends,
The State Freedom Caucus Network has grown rapidly over the last three years, so we thought it would be a good idea to introduce ourselves to all our new supporters and followers. If you missed our last five emails, we did a short Q&A with:
1. [Network President Andy Roth](https://substack.com/redirect/714c27b0-d42b-46c2-afe4-468bc78262d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
2. [Senior Vice President Justin Ouimette](https://substack.com/redirect/daa129c2-c5f5-4437-99b5-35d7af82a851?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
3. [VP of Development Dana Craycroft and Sr. Development Director Sara Prinzi](https://substack.com/redirect/799f1a12-42a1-46ea-aa5f-724d27adb070?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
4. [VP of Government Affairs Cesar Ybarra](https://substack.com/redirect/ce2ab875-6376-47bd-b665-c4c96e78858c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
5. [State Directors Connie Hair (LA) and Nathan Dahm (OK)](https://substack.com/redirect/c6807b50-284c-4540-8cf2-96433bc3d3f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

This week are two more of our amazing state directors representing Illinois (**Collin Moseley**) and Missouri (**Tim Jones**).
Two interesting facts about them - Collin plays three instruments - piano, guitar, and trumpet (which is 3 more instruments than I can play). Tim was a certified Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) who responded to the World Trade Center bombing in 1993. Enjoy!
* * *
**COLLIN MOSELEY**
**What is your role at SFCN?**__ I serve as the Illinois State Director. My primary tasks include formulating policy analysis and communications strategies that assist in making conservative legislators as effective as possible.
**Where are you from originally? Where do you live now?**__ I am proud to live right where I was born and raised - Clay County, Illinois. I live in southeastern Illinois, about 45 minutes from the Indiana border, and 2 hours north of Kentucky.
**Tell us about your family! And pets!** Just north of my hometown of Flora is a town called Louisville, still in Clay County. These two communities share a lot of interests and families, and I certainly did my part by marrying a Louisville girl that I met at our home church, Red Brush Christian Church. My wife Caitlyn and I have been married just under two years, and we have a 1 year old son named Ryker. We are very fortunate that the vast majority of both our families live right here in Clay County, so we are never short on family time and babysitters when needed!
**What's the best part of your job?** There are many parts of my job that I really enjoy. I am a policy person through and through. While working on an occasional campaign is fun - my real passion is dissecting a bill, and in Illinois usually finding out just how horrible it is, and then writing comments for members to tear it to shreds on the floor and in committee. I especially enjoy when these efforts cause other Republicans to make the right vote, when they otherwise would have suffered from liquid spine syndrome.
**How did you come to SFCN? What did you do before?**__ One day during my 8th grade year I was able to serve as an honorary page on the house floor in Springfield, Illinois. It was on that day that I caught the bug for public service and legislation. Fast forward a few years, I was studying political science at the University of Illinois on their Springfield campus, and working in the House Clerk's office. I then finished my degree online while working for State Senator Darren Bailey as a legislative aide, and later as Deputy Communications Director on his run for Governor. During that run I was acquainted with many brave, conservative lawmakers who would eventually make up the Illinois Freedom Caucus.
**Who or what most shaped your political philosophy/ideology?** This answer is a two parter. My grandfather, Lee Ryker, has had a great deal of influence over my life. He was our elected County Sheriff for several terms, in the same jail that I serve part-time with. His philosophy as a public servant is and was " It's about the people." Serving and working for the betterment of your community and those around you is all he has ever cared about, and I thought that was a trait worth following.
Specific to politics: Former Senator Darren Bailey and I spent many nights in the car when I was fresh out of college traveling Illinois - he poured a lot of conservative values into me that I hold true to today. I still learn a lot from our Freedom Caucus members every day, too. For some "philosophy" - I am usually intrigued by the writings of Edmund Burke, Hamilton, and the likes. Adding historical context to today's political issues interests me.
**Pick One To Answer: Favorite food? Favorite place to vacation? Favorite Book? Favorite Quote?**__ Chicago Style Pizza with Pepperoni.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e79baea3-cb86-44cc-a348-00f9f97aa7cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
**TIM JONES**
**What is your role at SFCN?** I am the Network's State Director for Missouri and the "Chief Cat Herder" of the Missouri Freedom Caucus. As a former Majority Leader, and Speaker of the Missouri House, I believe I bring a unique perspective and set of skills to the mission of helping the Missouri Freedom Caucus be the true North Star and conservative conscience of the General Assembly.
**Where are you from originally? Where do you live now?** I was born in Edina, Minnesota while my father and mother were stationed there in 1971. My father (now a retired veterinarian) was serving as a Captain in the US Army at the time so it was just happenstance that my two Missouri parents were temporarily farther north. We returned to the suburbs of St. Louis, Missouri in 1973. With the exception of the years of 1989-1998 when I largely lived in New York (Fordham University - 1993, St. John's University School of Law - 1996, Assistant District Attorney, County of Nassau - 1997-1998), my home has been in and around the southwest St. Louis County suburb of Eureka, Missouri (the home of Six Flags!)
**Tell us about your family! And pets!** Married to my wonderful and incredibly patient wife, Suzanne, for nearly 23 years. We have two brilliant, fantastic daughters, Katie & Abby. Katie is a sophomore at Drake University in Des Moines, Iowa. Abby is a sophomore in high school. We could not be more proud of them. We also have two entertaining cats, Jack & Oliver.
**What's the best part of your job?** As a former legislator, Majority Leader, and Speaker, I am thrilled, every day, to be working with an incredibly talented and motivated group of hard charging, brilliant, and hard working true conservatives and public servants. I consider it the highest and most important of responsibilities to do all I am able to share my nearly two decades of experience and knowledge working in and around politics and public policy with the members of the MOFC. When they succeed, our state, and yes, even our nation, succeeds. It is a weighty and humbling experience that I do not take lightly. It is definitely challenging, but it is also exhilarating, and often times, even fun.
**How did you come to SFCN? What did you do before?** A long and winding road has brought me to the SFCN. I practiced law for nearly two decades, served as President of the Board of Aldermen on my town's City Council, and then as a State Legislator. I have been on the "private sector side" of politics and public policy for over a decade now, working in the media and communications world (predominantly radio where I now run an evening drive show), and government affairs, almost entirely in the "freedom and liberty" space.
**Who or what most shaped your political philosophy/ideology?** I work hard to be grounded in my faith (Roman Catholic) and my family, and I consider myself a student and disciple of Thomas Jefferson, Ronald Reagan, Margaret Thatcher, & Winston Churchill. Never give up.
***Pick One To Answer*: Favorite food? Favorite place to vacation? Favorite Book? Favorite Quote.** "I have sworn upon the altar of God eternal hostility against every form of tyranny over the mind of man". - Thomas Jefferson

| Team,

On the first day of 2025, I officially signed the petition to get my name on the ballot to run for Governor of Virginia! This is a big first step in our campaign, and I’m incredibly excited to hit the road this year, meet Virginians across the Commonwealth, listen to their challenges and aspirations, and work hard to earn their support. [ ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/86436?t=6&akid=18679%2E878179%2E5vpHCb) But I need your help to make this a reality. To get my name on the ballot, I need to gather 10,000 signatures from voters all across Virginia. It’s a crucial step in the process, and it’s a big challenge—one that will take resources, staff, organization, and a lot of hard work. And this is only step one. Once we get on the ballot, then the real work begins.

My campaign is already working to organize events, mobilize volunteers, and fund the materials needed to collect these signatures—everything from petition forms to resources for our dedicated teams out in the field. To reach our goal and secure my place on the ballot, I’m counting on supporters like you to help fund this vital effort.

[Will you contribute today between my campaign and Voter Protection Project to help us gather the signatures we need and keep our momentum going? I’m writing to let you know about something I think you’ll find useful in your learning. Reason and speech are gifts from God that enable us to think about God and to worship Him. [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b7a2edd316c045ef9331e06b9179e3db&_e=XFXyDd_I7m-_QcmKFMoq7iRclJsHHXrQXJoZ1zMmW8Sfsrg0NCQoqIbV6G3DuIdVLt6Pe2hly_3a8xaMwTvLrjSQClh9FIV6h9DStB0spnDpuz_xq4j6jxYodRyhT5Wk4Dd5U-M9jtqdRmQzghNKj_4r_uBJkWrHTFJopFz3LYQeFS8jtcfUceZtM0rFH8y53NHHlHbXk6gIi6pW32Z9XXfiJWWfhBWd4lEK8QRJuBVVPRXBM1EnAhOYNFOgYgMRKTcFRa7i0YGltjr6Q2gQ_7YVNyQm9b7AA1FFWQR9gUIWmTiWuGnxQtztsPCGJtxkUeiA9jBlTYtSvRrBe8wSXUvgEf4jrabsLQ56Yho-kGCTGB1OtFXrs8ErDqhQUrG_zWQH8GQx3vRGgtZtfuKMVfmtH7j7OsM5gMZgrD555ZnsVYZqLfn1oj-wCml_G00jt9FRRisH7f9-35A9eLmZ9w%3D%3D) One of the chief aims of education at Hillsdale College is to understand what kind of being we are, as well as our purpose. That, in turn, makes it possible to begin to understand our relationship to God.

The study of God, also known as “theology,” has had a profound impact on Western civilization, stretching back thousands of years to the ancient Hebrews. And that’s what Hillsdale’s **“Theology 101”** online course is about—the development of theology from the Old Testament through the twentieth century.

**“Theology 101”** has been a popular course, so I’m pleased to let you know that it is [**now available for you to own on DVD**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b7a2edd316c045ef9331e06b9179e3db&_e=XFXyDd_I7m-_QcmKFMoq7iRclJsHHXrQXJoZ1zMmW8Sfsrg0NCQoqIbV6G3DuIdVLt6Pe2hly_3a8xaMwTvLrjSQClh9FIV6h9DStB0spnDpuz_xq4j6jxYodRyhT5Wk4Dd5U-M9jtqdRmQzghNKj_4r_uBJkWrHTFJopFz3LYQeFS8jtcfUceZtM0rFH8y53NHHlHbXk6gIi6pW32Z9XXfiJWWfhBWd4lEK8QRJuBVVPRXBM1EnAhOYNFOgYgMRKTcFRa7i0YGltjr6Q2gQ_7YVNyQm9b7AA1FFWQR9gUJWrlG69a21UQtP1fZpilkTLLDCIGG9ADEcOG0kKxmVV6UZ_XOyITo2ZvHg5V_-Pa6UXWZ0d9pToJGLHUN6TRabuX_05-bNSRMpbSfepz-fM22afO8fURBn04pZTcwEsmiZdk6QFDdk8jaVfpadhkc-jd7qFKaxiPwLccZhD1DeJw%3D%3D). You can add it to your home library or give it as a gift to a friend or relative.

We do have a limited number of sets in stock, though—and they go fast—so don’t delay in getting your copy of **“Theology 101”** on DVD. * **TOP NEWS**

"**Many UT applicants got deferrals in early action process,** " Houston Chronicle's **Samantha Ketterer** -- "**Skye Ross** ' parents and siblings met her at the pizzeria, ready to cheer her on at work while she opened her admissions letter from the University of Texas at Austin.

She had waited her whole life for this moment, though the real waiting began in October when she met an "early-action" submissions deadline promising results on Jan. 15. The day now here, the UT-loving family crowded around Ross at a high top table, and she opened the email to something she didn't know was possible.

The university told her it would give her its answer in a month - alongside the students who applied by the "regular decision" deadline in December.

"It felt like a denial," mother **Tiffani Ross** said. "It's very confusing when kids pull that up. When they applied early they should have a decision early, that's the whole point."
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/ec1fc6c7-9c46-4348-b0bb-602f3afd6046?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Only 5,000 students got acceptances by Jan. 15, out of the record [91,000](https://substack.com/redirect/9a46eb00-a4a8-4aec-b2a5-5d7e0a6b63c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) prospective freshmen who applied to UT-Austin for the fall 2025 semester, according to a leaked email from the admissions office. The admitted students represented only 25 to 30% of the expected number of offers, and no one in the overall pool received denials.

Most of the 5,000 current admits applied early action, and the other early action applicants who didn't get an offer yet were deferred. While the number of applicants was unprecedented, the first round of decisions confounded many students, parents and college admissions consultants. UT declined to clarify the breakdown of early and regular applicants, but the deferrals now mean that up to 86,000 letters will go out en masse on the regular decision date. Some decisions might be released earlier for smaller majors or automatic admits applying to specific majors, per the leaked email.

"This is the first year that UT offered an Early Action application window, and the review of Early Action applications is unfolding as planned," **Miguel Wasielewski** , interim senior vice president for strategic enrollment management, said in a statement.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/ec1fc6c7-9c46-4348-b0bb-602f3afd6046?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"The first wave of Early Action decisions was issued January 15 with one of four possible outcomes - admitted, deferred, denied or an alternative pathway," he said. "All Early Action applicants that were not accepted or declined by January 15 remain under review and will receive a decision on their application by February 15."

Skye Ross' and several other applicant's families didn't find the earliest communications so clear cut, they said. Some were familiar with deferral processes that require sending in more information before receiving acceptances, but this didn't seem to be the case.

"Thank you for meeting our Early Action deadline," the initial admissions status notification said. "The Office of Admissions is thoroughly reviewing your application for your selected major and we need some additional time. No further action is needed on your part. You can expect to receive your admission decision February 15."

Overnight, many parents said, their children's admissions status was updated to "deferred." Some were angry at what they viewed as a lack of transparency, and the leaked email confirming that only 5,000 people heard back - with an unknown number from regular decision - only worsened their irritation toward UT. Wasielewski acknowledged in a statement that "some confusion" occurred because the word "deferred" was not used, prompting the university to clarify students' statuses later in the day.

"It has definitely dimmed the shine that UT-Austin had," said **Sarah Hubbell** , of Katy, whose son received a deferral. "They say, love the school that loves you back."

The flagship introduced a slew of changes to its admissions process last year, coming off a season that garnered them a high of 73,000 applicants for fall 2024. Many high school students' GPAs were too close together, making it difficult to differentiate students and determine who was best suited for limited seats, Wasielewski said at the time. The admissions office reinstated test requirements, reintroduced a waitlist, provided more flexibility in the required essay and added a prompt for students to highlight an activity of their choice.

The school also announced a new early action deadline, ditching the use of a former "priority" deadline that encouraged students to apply early but left them unsure whether they would be benefited doing so. UT officials said the nonbinding early action deadline would not provide students an advantage in the review process but would give "a guaranteed decision communicated to applicants by Jan. 15."" TOP NEWS "Many UT applicants got deferrals in early action process, " Houston Chronicle's Samantha Ketterer -- "Skye Ross ' parents and siblings met her at the pizzeria, ready to cheer her on at work while she opened her admissions letter from the University of Texas at Austin. She had waited her whole life for this moment, though the real waiting began in October when she met an "early-action" submissions deadline promising results on Jan. 15. The day now here, the UT-loving family crowded around Ross at a high top table, and she opened the email to something she didn't know was possible. The university told her it would give her its answer in a month - alongside the students who applied by the "regular decision" deadline in December. "It felt like a denial," mother Tiffani Ross said. "It's very confusing when kids pull that up. When they applied early they should have a decision early, that's the whole point." Only 5,000 students got acceptances by Jan. 15, out of the record prospective freshmen who applied to UT-Austin for the fall 2025 semester, according to a leaked email from the admissions office. The admitted students represented only 25 to 30% of the expected number of offers, and no one in the overall pool received denials. Most of the 5,000 current admits applied early action, and the other early action applicants who didn't get an offer yet were deferred. While the number of applicants was unprecedented, the first round of decisions confounded many students, parents and college admissions consultants. UT declined to clarify the breakdown of early and regular applicants, but the deferrals now mean that up to 86,000 letters will go out en masse on the regular decision date. Some decisions might be released earlier for smaller majors or automatic admits applying to specific majors, per the leaked email. "This is the first year that UT offered an Early Action application window, and the review of Early Action applications is unfolding as planned," Miguel Wasielewski , interim senior vice president for strategic enrollment management, said in a statement. "The first wave of Early Action decisions was issued January 15 with one of four possible outcomes - admitted, deferred, denied or an alternative pathway," he said. "All Early Action applicants that were not accepted or declined by January 15 remain under review and will receive a decision on their application by February 15." Skye Ross' and several other applicant's families didn't find the earliest communications so clear cut, they said. Some were familiar with deferral processes that require sending in more information before receiving acceptances, but this didn't seem to be the case. "Thank you for meeting our Early Action deadline," the initial admissions status notification said. "The Office of Admissions is thoroughly reviewing your application for your selected major and we need some additional time. No further action is needed on your part. You can expect to receive your admission decision February 15." Overnight, many parents said, their children's admissions status was updated to "deferred." Some were angry at what they viewed as a lack of transparency, and the leaked email confirming that only 5,000 people heard back - with an unknown number from regular decision - only worsened their irritation toward UT. Wasielewski acknowledged in a statement that "some confusion" occurred because the word "deferred" was not used, prompting the university to clarify students' statuses later in the day. "It has definitely dimmed the shine that UT-Austin had," said Sarah Hubbell , of Katy, whose son received a deferral. "They say, love the school that loves you back." The flagship introduced a slew of changes to its admissions process last year, coming off a season that garnered them a high of 73,000 applicants for fall 2024. Many high school students' GPAs were too close together, making it difficult to differentiate students and determine who was best suited for limited seats, Wasielewski said at the time. The admissions office reinstated test requirements, reintroduced a waitlist, provided more flexibility in the required essay and added a prompt for students to highlight an activity of their choice. The school also announced a new early action deadline, ditching the use of a former "priority" deadline that encouraged students to apply early but left them unsure whether they would be benefited doing so. UT officials said the nonbinding early action deadline would not provide students an advantage in the review process but would give "a guaranteed decision communicated to applicants by Jan. 15."" She had waited her whole life for this moment, though the real waiting began in October when she met an “early-action” submissions deadline promising results on Jan. 15. The day now here, the UT-loving family crowded around Ross at a high top table, and she opened the email to something she didn't know was possible.

The university told her it would give her its answer in a month – alongside the students who applied by the “regular decision” deadline in December.

The admissions office reinstated test requirements, reintroduced a waitlist, provided more flexibility in the required essay and added a prompt for students to highlight an activity of their choice.

Sign up now at | TOP NEWS “Many UT applicants got deferrals in early action process, ” Houston Chronicle's Samantha Ketterer — “Skye Ross ’ parents and siblings met her at the pizzeria, ready to cheer her on at work while she opened her admissions letter from the University of Texas at Austin. She had waited her whole life for this moment, though the real waiting began in October when she met an “early-action” submissions deadline promising results on Jan. 15. The day now here, the UT-loving family crowded around Ross at a high top table, and she opened the email to something she didn't know was possible. The university told her it would give her its answer in a month – alongside the students who applied by the “regular decision” deadline in December. “It felt like a denial,” mother Tiffani Ross said. “It’s very confusing when kids pull that up. When they applied early they should have a decision early, that’s the whole point.” » Only 5,000 students got acceptances by Jan. 15, out of the record prospective freshmen who applied to UT-Austin for the fall 2025 semester, according to a leaked email from the admissions office. The admitted students represented only 25 to 30% of the expected number of offers, and no one in the overall pool received denials. Most of the 5,000 current admits applied early action, and the other early action applicants who didn't get an offer yet were deferred. While the number of applicants was unprecedented, the first round of decisions confounded many students, parents and college admissions consultants. UT declined to clarify the breakdown of early and regular applicants, but the deferrals now mean that up to 86,000 letters will go out en masse on the regular decision date. Some decisions might be released earlier for smaller majors or automatic admits applying to specific majors, per the leaked email. “This is the first year that UT offered an Early Action application window, and the review of Early Action applications is unfolding as planned,” Miguel Wasielewski , interim senior vice president for strategic enrollment management, said in a statement. » "The first wave of Early Action decisions was issued January 15 with one of four possible outcomes – admitted, deferred, denied or an alternative pathway," he said. "All Early Action applicants that were not accepted or declined by January 15 remain under review and will receive a decision on their application by February 15.” Skye Ross' and several other applicant's families didn’t find the earliest communications so clear cut, they said. Some were familiar with deferral processes that require sending in more information before receiving acceptances, but this didn’t seem to be the case. “Thank you for meeting our Early Action deadline,” the initial admissions status notification said. “The Office of Admissions is thoroughly reviewing your application for your selected major and we need some additional time. No further action is needed on your part. You can expect to receive your admission decision February 15.” Overnight, many parents said, their children’s admissions status was updated to “deferred.” Some were angry at what they viewed as a lack of transparency, and the leaked email confirming that only 5,000 people heard back – with an unknown number from regular decision – only worsened their irritation toward UT. Wasielewski acknowledged in a statement that "some confusion" occurred because the word "deferred" was not used, prompting the university to clarify students' statuses later in the day. "It has definitely dimmed the shine that UT-Austin had," said Sarah Hubbell , of Katy, whose son received a deferral. "They say, love the school that loves you back." The flagship introduced a slew of changes to its admissions process last year, coming off a season that garnered them a high of 73,000 applicants for fall 2024. Many high school students' GPAs were too close together, making it difficult to differentiate students and determine who was best suited for limited seats, Wasielewski said at the time. The admissions office reinstated test requirements, reintroduced a waitlist, provided more flexibility in the required essay and added a prompt for students to highlight an activity of their choice. The school also announced a new early action deadline, ditching the use of a former "priority" deadline that encouraged students to apply early but left them unsure whether they would be benefited doing so. UT officials said the nonbinding early action deadline would not provide students an advantage in the review process but would give "a guaranteed decision communicated to applicants by Jan. 15."" Derek,
Last week, I questioned Pete Hegseth, Donald Trump’s defense secretary pick, at his confirmation hearing.
This email isn’t about the multiple allegations of wildly inappropriate behavior by Hegseth — from abuse of women, to serial infidelity, to fiscal mismanagement, to working while under the influence of alcohol. It’s about my concern that he, and many of Trump’s other nominees, can’t be trusted to be honest with the American people.
And more than that, it’s about how incredibly important these hearings are.
These are incredibly serious jobs. In turn, it's our job as committee members – and as representatives of the American people – to bring the truth to light before the Senate votes.
Which brings me to my friend Mark. Mark has been taking the reins at other key confirmation hearings – and I want to ask you a favor: He’s on the ballot in 2026, and I want to let him know we have his back today. Can you split a $5 donation between his re-election campaign and my Common Ground PAC right now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025-warner]
I know he won’t let you down.
Much appreciated,
Tim Kaine

Random sticker pasted on a pole near my law office.
Go out and whoop it up this weekend. You made it through week one of the second Trump presidency. Only [1,456 more days to go. Click](https://substack.com/redirect/4bf1cf9b-737b-4223-8a33-90dc248377be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to find a handy day-counter.
The week of January 27-31, 2025 should be action-packed.
### Where are we with the Special Election in NY-21?
In NY-21 we are edging closer to the point at which the Special Election kicks off. Reminder: for that to happen, Stefanik's nomination to be our nation's UN Ambassador has to be confirmed by a floor vote in the Senate. She has to get Trump to sign the document. She will then resign from her congressional seat. NY Gov Kathy Hochul has to call a Special Election. The respective parties will then announce their candidates.
On the Democratic side, I'm told we are down to four of us still under consideration. I have lost count how many Republicans have expressed interest. In some ways it doesn't matter. In talking with members of the press, they believe that Stefanik and Trump will announce the nominee in a joint statement. I don't know. I don't pretend to understand the inner workings of MAGAs.
I have had a few highlights in the press. Thank you to [Jeff Cole at Watertown Ch 7](https://substack.com/redirect/df28e7e4-423b-44d1-a8e6-3b69be79326c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and to [Kate Lisa with Spectrum 1](https://substack.com/redirect/134d65ce-2ba8-4b77-b2f9-186df5e564f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
### Politics is all about people
It is my sincere belief that politics is all about people. For that reason, I am spending about 2-3 hours a day on "call time", not just for the purpose of fundraising, but to ask people if they can talk to me about issues, platform, and messaging. Clearly the Democrats have lessons to learn. I want to hear from people what they think about how to correct the prior mistakes.
I'm running on a platform to show voters how Democrats put food on the table, gas in the car, and keep a roof overhead. Some voters think that is perfect. Others want to talk about climate change (always high on my priority list), women's issues, LGBT rights, and the border.
### "Paula -- are you fundraising?"
One voter asked if I was fundraising. "Why yes I am. Can I send you a link?"
"Well", she said, "I just get bombarded with email, text, and Facebook ads from such-and-such a candidate, who says that he is the Democrat running for NY21. Why aren't you doing that?"
**Quick answer: this is what I can live with.**
**Ethically and morally I have a problem with hitting my supporters up repeatedly as if they are ATM machines at a time when we really do not know who the nominee will be.**
I am, indeed, fundraising. Some of you reading this have been faithfully donating to my campaign, and it is much appreciated. I referred the inquiring person to my Substack, my website, and I offered to send a link.
### Democrats have a BS meter
I am really aware that Democrats have a very sensitive BS meter. I just don't think it's right for me to go hard and heavy into fundraising, and hold myself out as the chosen nominee, when that is simply not the truth. **It 's not who I am as a person. It's not who we are as a party.**
My ethical and moral position, and my decision to engage in "soft" fundraising while we are in the wait-and-see period could very well cost me the nomination. The county chairs may decide that my fundraising is lame, and that they want to advance someone else's name to the ballot. That is a risk I need to take in order to stay true to my core beliefs. And if that happens, I assure you that I will promote that other person's candidacy on social media, in the spirit of Democratic party unity.
### My candidacy presents the best path forward in NY-21
I maintain that my candidacy presents the Democrats in NY-21 the best path forward. Repeatedly during the general election, voters expressed that they wanted to see the same candidate run in multiple cycles. In such a large district, it's hard for people to get to know the candidate otherwise. I got more votes than any other candidate has gotten in the NY21 race, despite the challenges of a congressional district map that pumped an additional 50,000 registered Republicans into the district in February 2024, causing our record raw numbers to be matched with a drop in margins. I know this district, its data, its geography, and its volunteers, better than any other prospective candidate for the Democratic line on the ballot. I'm solidly middle class, a proud union member. I understand the struggles firsthand how hard it is to put food on the table, gas in the car, and keep a roof overhead.
### Accountability
Once elected, I will hold myself accountable to voters through regular Town Hall meetings, presence in the district (all 15 counties) and Zoom meetings.
Thousands of upstate New York Democrats worked really hard to get seats flipped in districts that are adjacent to NY21. I know. There were many occasions when volunteers would say, "Nope. Can't canvass for you. I'm driving over to help out with the campaigns in _____'s race." Understood. The state party conveyed the importance of the seats in the coordinated campaign.
### Upstate Congressional votes on The Laken Riley Act
But - golly gee - the first week that these Red-to-Blue winners are in Congress, they voted with the Republicans on the Laken Riley Act! That's the act that opens the door for law enforcement to detain undocumented immigrants accused of even minor crimes.
Want someone deported? Just tell a law enforcement officer that you think they look like someone who may have done something wrong. Once that person is arrested, they can face deportation immediately upon release - even if they are innocent of the alleged crime. No due process. No innocent until proven guilty. The immigration law does not follow what they show you on TV crime shows.
The votes on the Laken Riley Act were upsetting to the people who worked hard to get these Democratic representatives elected. It would be nice to hear from them how they came to their respective conclusions as to how to vote. Maybe if they explained themselves, their supporters could see things from a different perspective.
Honestly - I'm tired of calling various local and state elected officials and getting voice mail. Don't they have interns? Does anybody EVER answer their phones once they move into the congressional office buildings? I can tell you from experience, just having a live human on the other end of the line is showing respect, and it's something I intend to provide once I am in office.
**My two cents: accountability is key to rebuilding our Democratic Party.**
### The race for DNC Chair
In addition to the Special Election getting more definition next week, we also have the Democratic National Committee (DNC) vote for party Chair. This seat was previously held by Jaime Harrison, who announced on November 6, 2024, after the party suffered bruising defeats in the general election, that he would not seek re-election.
The DNC Chair's responsibilities are broadly defined in the party's rules. They are to remain impartial when the Democratic party is in the process of choosing presidential nominees. They are to work with state and local party officials as cheerleaders, fundraisers, administrators, and recruiters. More than that, in my opinion, they set the tone for how we are going to build our party's platform. Interestingly, Indivisible, which is not a part of the Democratic party but is, instead, a great partner organization, has an excellent explanation of the DNC Chair's responsibilities [here](https://substack.com/redirect/27227da9-e84e-4aee-aba0-135616c9fe3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
There have been a lot of candidates who have gathered the required 40 nominations to officially run for DMC Chair. There is a list here on [Wikipedia](https://substack.com/redirect/3c95caba-bba2-4bc7-838d-d7d455f8a34c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Not pictured on that Wikipedia page is [Dr. Quintessa Hathaway](https://substack.com/redirect/2fc581ae-4faf-4f47-90a5-cd5d0f7c64bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from Arkansas, who presents a platform that has much more focus on civil rights, voter registration, and building Democratic coalitions in the South than the other candidates.
Thus far, the front runners seem to be Ken Martin, from Minnesota; Ben Wikler, from Wisconsin; and Martin O'Malley, from Maryland. Each has their ideas about how to move forward in terms of fundraising, overall tone of the party, and how to win back voters.
### New York had a contender
New York Senator James Skoufis was seeking the nomination, but has now withdrawn. He realized he simply did not have the votes. I heard Sen. Skoufis speak at a DNC Chair nominee panel sponsored by the Democratic Rural Conference. He mentioned a conversation with Assembly Member Billy Jones, who was widely speculated to be a pick for the congressional race in NY-21. After Jones decided not to run, Skoufis called him and asked if anyone from the national party had reached out to him to ask about NY-21. Jones' response: no. Skoufis thought this was puzzling, given the importance of the Special Election.
I was able to speak on the phone with Sen. Skoufis. I explained that this kind of sympathetic-but-nonetheless-brushoff from the state and national Democratic parties in NY-21 is something we are really familiar with. He expressed soft outrage, and the hope that a new DNC chair will turn things around, especially for rural districts.
### Are Democrats ready for a populist DNC Chair?
Faiz Shakir is a latecomer to the race for DNC chair. Formerly the Campaign Manager for Bernie Sanders' presidential campaign, Shakir asks the existential questions out loud. Where are we going to get voters? And what are we going to really deliver in order to earn their support? Shakir proposes stepping out of the normal Starbucks-sipping venues of well-educated, upper-income circles, and returning to our populist, middle class, union member roots. ["We cannot expect working-class audiences to see us any differently if we are not offering anything new or substantive to attract their support."](https://substack.com/redirect/aece842e-65d3-4212-9100-8f775712a246?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### What does this have to do with you, me, or the race in NY-21?
### The Special Elections will be held within weeks of the election of the new DNC chair. Whoever emerges as the new chair will want to prove themselves quickly.
My hope, of course, is that the race will garner national attention and support, especially from the DNC.
### But we still have a voter registration problem in NY-21.
Despite any state or national party leader's personal inclination, there still needs to be solid strategy behind investment in the race in NY-21.
Democrats have a voter registration problem in NY-21. In the coming weeks you will hear more from me on that topic.
We have a deficit of some 81,000 active Democratic-leaning voters in NY-21, compared with active registered Republican-leaning voters. If you vote in NY-21 and you are not registered as a Democrat or as a member of the Working Families Party (WFP), I ask you to consider changing your party registration. [It isn't difficult to do, and there is time to do so.](https://substack.com/redirect/087e8836-e6b2-4505-9304-41de6c837262?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### This is why the state and national parties skip over NY-21.
The numbers in NY 21 tell the story as to why the party has been reluctant to put us in a well-supported coordinated campaign as they did in our neighboring congressional districts. In NY-21, we have:
> 213,743 active Republican + Conservative Party voters
> 132,559 active Dem + WFP voters
> 145,971 active Blank or Independent voters
If you are one of the Blank or Independent voters (or if you are a registered Republican who votes Blue!) you can make a big difference in rebuilding the Democratic Party in upstate NY by changing your voter registration. Any positive movement in voter registrations into the "Blue" category will certainly help us to get state and national party support.
Here is a [link to the New York State site](https://substack.com/redirect/087e8836-e6b2-4505-9304-41de6c837262?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to change your voter registration online.
Stay tuned. I'm gonna keep teaching and preaching about this topic.
Til then, manage your news so you stay informed but not overwhelmed, and stay warm!

I know this district, its data, its geography, and its volunteers, better than any other prospective candidate for the Democratic line on the ballot. I'm solidly middle class, a proud union member. I understand the struggles firsthand how hard it is to put food on the table, gas in the car, and keep a roof overhead. Accountability Once elected, I will hold myself accountable to voters through regular Town Hall meetings, presence in the district (all 15 counties) and Zoom meetings. Thousands of upstate New York Democrats worked really hard to get seats flipped in districts that are adjacent to NY21. I know. There were many occasions when volunteers would say, "Nope. Can't canvass for you. I'm driving over to help out with the campaigns in ___'s race." Understood. The state party conveyed the importance of the seats in the coordinated campaign. Upstate Congressional votes on The Laken Riley Act But - golly gee - the first week that these Red-to-Blue winners are in Congress, they voted with the Republicans on the Laken Riley Act! That's the act that opens the door for law enforcement to detain undocumented immigrants accused of even minor crimes. Want someone deported? Just tell a law enforcement officer that you think they look like someone who may have done something wrong. Once that person is arrested, they can face deportation immediately upon release - even if they are innocent of the alleged crime. No due process. No innocent until proven guilty. The immigration law does not follow what they show you on TV crime shows. The votes on the Laken Riley Act were upsetting to the people who worked hard to get these Democratic representatives elected. It would be nice to hear from them how they came to their respective conclusions as to how to vote. Maybe if they explained themselves, their supporters could see things from a different perspective. Honestly - I'm tired of calling various local and state elected officials and getting voice mail. Don't they have interns? Does anybody EVER answer their phones once they move into the congressional office buildings? I can tell you from experience, just having a live human on the other end of the line is showing respect, and it's something I intend to provide once I am in office. My two cents: accountability is key to rebuilding our Democratic Party.** The race for DNC Chair In addition to the Special Election getting more definition next week, we also have the Democratic National Committee (DNC) vote for party Chair. This seat was previously held by Jaime Harrison, who announced on November 6, 2024, after the party suffered bruising defeats in the general election, that he would not seek re-election. The DNC Chair's responsibilities are broadly defined in the party's rules. They are to remain impartial when the Democratic party is in the process of choosing presidential nominees. They are to work with state and local party officials as cheerleaders, fundraisers, administrators, and recruiters. More than that, in my opinion, they set the tone for how we are going to build our party's platform. Interestingly, Indivisible, which is not a part of the Democratic party but is, instead, a great partner organization, has an excellent explanation of the DNC Chair's responsibilities . There have been a lot of candidates who have gathered the required 40 nominations to officially run for DMC Chair. There is a list here on . Not pictured on that Wikipedia page is from Arkansas, who presents a platform that has much more focus on civil rights, voter registration, and building Democratic coalitions in the South than the other candidates. Thus far, the front runners seem to be Ken Martin, from Minnesota; Ben Wikler, from Wisconsin; and Martin O'Malley, from Maryland. Each has their ideas about how to move forward in terms of fundraising, overall tone of the party, and how to win back voters. New York had a contender New York Senator James Skoufis was seeking the nomination, but has now withdrawn. He realized he simply did not have the votes. I heard Sen. Skoufis speak at a DNC Chair nominee panel sponsored by the Democratic Rural Conference. He mentioned a conversation with Assembly Member Billy Jones, who was widely speculated to be a pick for the congressional race in NY-21. After Jones decided not to run, Skoufis called him and asked if anyone from the national party had reached out to him to ask about NY-21. Jones' response: no. Skoufis thought this was puzzling, given the importance of the Special Election. I was able to speak on the phone with Sen. Skoufis. I explained that this kind of sympathetic-but-nonetheless-brushoff from the state and national Democratic parties in NY-21 is something we are really familiar with. He expressed soft outrage, and the hope that a new DNC chair will turn things around, especially for rural districts. Are Democrats ready for a populist DNC Chair? Faiz Shakir is a latecomer to the race for DNC chair. Formerly the Campaign Manager for Bernie Sanders' presidential campaign, Shakir asks the existential questions out loud. Where are we going to get voters? And what are we going to really deliver in order to earn their support? Shakir proposes stepping out of the normal Starbucks-sipping venues of well-educated, upper-income circles, and returning to our populist, middle class, union member roots. What does this have to do with you, me, or the race in NY-21? The Special Elections will be held within weeks of the election of the new DNC chair. Whoever emerges as the new chair will want to prove themselves quickly. My hope, of course, is that the race will garner national attention and support, especially from the DNC. But we still have a voter registration problem in NY-21. Despite any state or national party leader's personal inclination, there still needs to be solid strategy behind investment in the race in NY-21. Democrats have a voter registration problem in NY-21. In the coming weeks you will hear more from me on that topic. We have a deficit of some 81,000 active Democratic-leaning voters in NY-21, compared with active registered Republican-leaning voters. If you vote in NY-21 and you are not registered as a Democrat or as a member of the Working Families Party (WFP), I ask you to consider changing your party registration. This is why the state and national parties skip over NY-21. The numbers in NY 21 tell the story as to why the party has been reluctant to put us in a well-supported coordinated campaign as they did in our neighboring congressional districts. In NY-21, we have: 213,743 active Republican + Conservative Party voters 132,559 active Dem + WFP voters 145,971 active Blank or Independent voters If you are one of the Blank or Independent voters (or if you are a registered Republican who votes Blue!) you can make a big difference in rebuilding the Democratic Party in upstate NY by changing your voter registration. Any positive movement in voter registrations into the "Blue" category will certainly help us to get state and national party support. Here is a to change your voter registration online. Stay tuned. I'm gonna keep teaching and preaching about this topic. Til then, manage your news so you stay informed but not overwhelmed, and stay warm! If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democrat who ran in New York's 21st Congressional District. I hope to run in the Special Election in 2025. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. Donations are much appreciated. name: PoliticsPA
subject: PA voters are shifting with the nation
body:
Tune into the latest installment of the Voices of Reason podcast. | | | |
---
| | | Welcome to the latest edition of _Voices of Reason_ where we’ll recap exclusive news and data featured in our most recent podcast.

The political realignment shaking the nation has hit Pennsylvania. This episode unpacks the seismic shifts from Election 2024 and their implications for PA Democrats and Republicans during this transformative moment in politics.

CEO of _Broad + Liberty_ , **Terry Tracy,** and Education Reporter for _Broad + Liberty_ ,**Beth Ann Rosica** share insights you don’t want to miss.
---
| **Big Names Make News**
---
| **CEO of _Broad + Liberty_ Terry Tracy** critiques Kamala Harris's purported "word salad," highlighting how Democrats' communication style is alienating working-class voters. [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=9a39f69583&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**Education Reporter for _Broad + Liberty_ Beth Ann Rosica** explores whether or not Governor Josh will support the Save Women's Sports Act. "He has sworn to veto that bill, he is on the record as saying he's going to veto that bill." [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=4183aeaee0&e=b7b3eddce2)]
---
|
* * *
---
| **Numbers You Need to Know**
---
| _Public Opinion_
* For the first time since 2008, Centre County has more registered Republicans than Democrats, with **42,165 Republicans** and 41,460 Democrats. [[CentreDaily](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=2e3ea9f87e&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* Heading into Election Day, the trends told the story: Trump led in only 2 of 59 Pennsylvania polls in 2016, just 5 of 84 in 2020, but in 2024, he led in **half of the 82 polls** released. [[RealClearPennsylvania](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c2e4a210a5&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Voter Interests_
* On Trump's first day of office, he signed **dozens of executive orders** into action and proposed **25% tariffs** on products from Canada and Mexico. [[WHYY](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=44d499971a&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Elections_
* PA reported **1,959,702 mail-in ballots last election** , but state law bars counting those with incorrect or missing envelope dates. An NAACP lawsuit, if overturned by the Supreme Court, could boost accepted ballot totals.. [[D](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=f675a37c6b&e=b7b3eddce2)[emocracyDocket](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e42045aeaf&e=b7b3eddce2)]

---
|
* * *
---
| **Tax fatigue rises with a 23% hike in Delaware, 36% in Allegheny, and beyond.**
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=2af5ba102d&e=b7b3eddce2 "Political Shift Rocks PA: Winners, Losers, and What’s Ahead | Voices of Reason Ep. 11")
---
|
* * *
---
| **In Case You Missed It...**
---
| The _Voices of Reason_ podcast has covered the most important issues in Pennsylvania politics – from [education funding](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e37a655313&e=b7b3eddce2) to [trust in elections](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=229114f3cf&e=b7b3eddce2). Secretary of the Commonwealth [Al Schmidt](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0d72ec4134&e=b7b3eddce2), PA Treasurer [Stacy Garrity](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=1991f146d4&e=b7b3eddce2), and House Appropriations Chairman [Jordan Harris](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=54d5eff615&e=b7b3eddce2) are just a few of many influential guests who have joined us for exclusive interviews and roundtable discussions.
Visit the _Voice of Reason_ [YouTube page](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e28105381f&e=b7b3eddce2) to experience all the great moments you missed.
---
|
* * *
---
| **Get in Touch**
---
| We like smart ideas and want to hear from you.

Send feedback and inquire about appearing on _Voices of Reason_ , at [press@politicspa.com](mailto:press@politicspa.com?subject=Voices%20of%20Reason%20Podcast%20Inquiry).

Friend,

In less than EIGHT hours, the Senate is voting on whether to confirm President Trump’s nominee for Secretary of Defense. His name is Pete Hegseth and **he’s a truly awful person**.**

Hegseth is a Fox News commentator who’s been credibly accused of sexual assault and spousal abuse.** According to a 2017 police report, he **sexually assaulted a drunk woman** in a hotel and according to recent FBI interviews, his second wife had an “**escape plan** ” and a **safe word to tell her family** in case she had to flee his physical abuse.

Hegseth is also known to regularly abuse alcohol and has made _outrageous statements like that women shouldn’t be able to vote and that all Muslims should be killed_.__

This man__ is Donald Trump’s choice to run the Pentagon – and the most powerful military in the world.
|
