But it’s not too late to stop an unqualified and deeply dangerous (credibly accused) rapist from becoming Secretary of Defense and endangering the whole world._

As it stands, 49 Senators oppose his confirmation and some others still are publicly undecided. **All it would take is two more NO votes to stop his nomination** in its tracks and send a clear message to the Trump administration that they can’t get away with this. _We’re making the final push to tell the Senate to reject Hegseth in the next few _crucial_ hours._

According to a 2017 police report, he sexually assaulted a drunk woman in a hotel and according to recent FBI interviews, his second wife had an “escape plan ” and a safe word to tell her family in case she had to flee his physical abuse. Hegseth is also known to regularly abuse alcohol and has made outrageous statements like that women shouldn’t be able to vote and that all Muslims should be killed. This man is Donald Trump’s choice to run the Pentagon – and the most powerful military in the world. | | | These obvious liabilities mean that we can’t let Hegseth near any position of power, let alone one that could compromise national security. He’s vulnerable to being bribed or blackmailed by foreign governments and can’t be trusted to oversee our military with his history of alcohol abuse, racism, sexism, and sexual assault. But it’s not too late to stop an unqualified and deeply dangerous (credibly accused) rapist from becoming Secretary of Defense and endangering the whole world. As it stands, 49 Senators oppose his confirmation and some others still are publicly undecided. All it would take is two more NO votes to stop his nomination in its tracks and send a clear message to the Trump administration that they can’t get away with this. We’re making the final push to tell the Senate to reject Hegseth in the next few crucial hours. | | | | | | | | | After you’ve chipped in, call your Senators and demand that they vote against Hegseth’s nomination and calling on the entire Senate to do the same. # **Mass Deportations Have Begun...**
---
|
---
| | | | Hello friend, The largest mass deportation operation in U.S. history is underway. Hundreds of immigrants, many of them fleeing violence and unimaginable hardship, are being arrested and flown out of the country, often without the chance to have their cases fairly heard. This isn’t justice—it’s cruelty on a massive scale. Deportation flights have begun, with Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) detaining over 500 people in a single day. Raids are tearing families apart, targeting vulnerable communities, and creating fear in cities across America. These mass deportations are not only inhumane—they are a moral stain on our nation. Sending military aircraft to deport people who have crossed the border seeking safety does nothing to address the root causes of migration. Instead of providing real solutions, this administration uses fear and dehumanization as tools to score political points. Policies like expedited removals and denying asylum seekers even the chance to plead their cases are violations of human rights, plain and simple. America was built by immigrants and thrives because of the diversity and contributions of people from all walks of life. These mass deportations betray the values of compassion, justice, and opportunity that define us as a nation. We need real leadership—leadership that prioritizes **humane, effective solutions** over reckless cruelty. Instead of terrorizing families and tearing communities apart, we should focus on comprehensive immigration reform that addresses the systemic issues driving migration. We must invest in fair asylum processes, support humane border management, and work with international partners to address the root causes of migration, such as poverty and violence. [**_This moment calls for action. We cannot stand idly by while our leaders treat human beings as disposable. We must demand better. Call to Action: Join us in fighting for humane immigration policies. Together, we can protect families, honor our values, and create a system that works for everyone._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2w71pb-uc3f9j-kyd76rh0/)

The people of Missouri spoke, but extremists still refuse to listen. Peter, I want to be clear about something: **Reproductive rights are still under relentless attack.**

But the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ wasn’t the beginning of the fight against choice in Missouri.

Even before the _Dobbs_ decision, Missouri had one of the most restrictive abortion laws in the country – while abortion was available, Missouri Republicans made it near impossible for many to receive the care they needed.

After the fall of _Roe,_ Missouri became the first state to ban abortion entirely. An action to further strip away the right to access safe reproductive healthcare for women and families across our state.

Now, Missourians are facing yet another fight to protect reproductive rights. Even though a historic number of voters enshrined reproductive rights in our state’s constitution, Missouri Republicans are still working overtime to block progress. Even before the Dobbs decision, Missouri had one of the most restrictive abortion laws in the country – while abortion was available, Missouri Republicans made it near impossible for many to receive the care they needed. After the fall of Roe, Missouri became the first state to ban abortion entirely. An action to further strip away the right to access safe reproductive healthcare for women and families across our state. Now, Missourians are facing yet another fight to protect reproductive rights. Even though a historic number of voters enshrined reproductive rights in our state’s constitution, Missouri Republicans are still working overtime to block progress. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | | = | | = ---|---|---|---|--- = | | = | | = ---|---|---|---|--- Here’s the hard truth: Republican extremists are doubling down on their attacks – threatening access to birth control, IVF treatments, and other essential reproductive health services. Their agenda is CLEAR: They don't care about what's right for the people they were elected to serve. They care about control. I believe that every American deserves the right to make their own decisions about their body, their future, and their family. We need leaders who will fight for that freedom, not tear it away. That’s why I’m committed to restoring and protecting the reproductive rights that millions of Americans rely on. When we organize, we win.

name: Bera Headquarters
subject: New newsletter for the new year!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Bera for Congress
body:
Hi Peter,

We’re almost a month into 2025, and we’re excited to share the latest updates on what Rep. Ami Bera has been working on for Sacramento County and beyond. From his leadership role on the House Foreign Foreign Affairs Committee to his ongoing efforts to support local communities, there’s plenty to catch up on. Please take a moment to read on about what Ami’s been up to!
# [#]Continuing his leadership on the House Foreign
Affairs Committee:
→ Congressman Ami Bera continues his leadership on the House Foreign Affairs Committee as the Ranking Member of the Subcommittee on East Asia and Pacific in the 119th Congress. Ami is focused on advancing a free and open Indo-Pacific to continue fostering peace and stability in the region, which is incredibly important to US national security, economic interests, and shared values. He remains committed to working across the aisle to address key challenges, including countering China’s aggressive and coercive actions, securing critical supply chains, and strengthening multilateral alliances.
Dr. Ami Bera appeared live on POLITICO’s AI Panel at Playbook:
photo Dr. Ami Bera on the AI Discussion panel [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/90578/images/bera.png]
→ Ami Bera joined a panel of experts to give his insights on America’s competitiveness in the AI race against China, along with Senator John Curtis, OpenAI’s Vice President of Global Affairs Chris Lehane, and Wiley Rein’s Hon. Nazak Nikakhtar. Check out the panel by clicking here! [https://x.com/POLITICOLive/status/1879185574969356600]
Honoring the life and legacy of former President Jimmy Carter:
→ Ami had the privilege of honoring the life and legacy of President Jimmy Carter at the Washington National Cathedral in early January. We reflect on President Carter’s contributions, and remember him as a great American who dedicated his life to creating a better, kinder, and more peaceful world during his presidency and throughout his life.
Federal commitment to support victims of the LA wildfires:
→ Ami has supported providing the necessary relief to help those impacted by natural disasters throughout his time in Congress, and continued that approach in response to the devastating wildfires in L.A. County. He joined Senator Alex Padilla, Senator Adam Schiff, and 46 other Members of the California delegation in supporting Joe Biden’s swift approval of a major disaster declaration.
Sworn in for the 119th Congress:
→ Dr. Ami Bera was honored to be reelected last November and sworn in January 3rd to begin his seventh term as a member of the 119th Congress! WhenAmi was first sworn in twelve years ago, he was the sole Indian American Member of Congress and only the third in U.S. history. Today, Ami is the longest serving Indian American in history and stands among a coalition of six. He is proud to continue representing residents of Sacramento County and California’s 6th congressional district in Washington, DC.
Certified the Election:
→ On January 6th, Ami joined his House and Senate colleagues in order to fulfill their constitutional duty of certifying the results of the 2024 presidential election. As you well know, the complete opposite situation unfolded, four years ago, when a mob stormed the Capitol in an attempt to disrupt the certification of the legitimate 2020 election results. Ami will continue to fight for the American people and protect our democracy.
End of Year District Statistics:
→ During the last Congress, Ami’s team resolved over 6,600 constituent cases and returned more than $5,000,000 to Sacramento County taxpayers. This includes assisting residents with stalled passports and tax returns, helping seniors access Social Security and Medicare benefits, and ensuring veterans receive the benefits they have earned. He also helped secure over $295,000,000 in federal funding and grants to improve the Sacramento region’s infrastructure, economy, and more.
Thank you, Joe:
→ Thank you, President Joe Biden, for being a president for all Americans, and reminding us that this a land of possibilities and nothing is beyond our capacity when we work together. Thank you, Joe, for your 50+ years of service to our great nation.

As we look ahead to the rest of 2025, Ami remains committed to serving Sacramento County and tackling the challenges facing our nation.

To get in touch with Ami’s congressional office, call 916-635-0505 or visit bera.house.gov [https://bera.house.gov] to learn more.

Thank you for your support!

— Bera Headquarters

name: Senator Roger Hauck
subject: Save MI Tips!
body:
Michigan's workers deserve policies that

| | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/brightsparkstrategies/up-next-the-michigan-senate-11036050?e=9ec31248a9)
---
| | | |
---
| Neighbor,
The future of tipped wage employees and earned sick time requirements is one of the most significant issues affecting thousands of hardworking Michigan residents and small businesses. These policies impact the livelihoods of restaurant workers, the operations of family-owned businesses, and the overall strength of our local communities.
Following a court order late last year, the legislature is now required to address changes to laws adopted in 2018. These decisions will shape how workers earn wages and take time off when they need it most.
Thankfully, just last week, House Republicans, under the leadership of Rep. Bill G. Schuette, took decisive action to protect workers and small businesses. Their reforms preserve the tipped wage credit and amend employee sick time policies to better reflect the needs of Michigan residents. These changes help ensure that small businesses, the backbone of our economy, are not burdened by one-size-fits-all regulations that could harm jobs and working conditions.
The House Select Committee on Protecting Employees and Small Businesses, chaired by Rep. Schuette, passed House Bills 4001 and 4002. HB 4001 ensures that tipped employees continue to receive 38% of the minimum wage—a measure supported by restaurant workers across the state. This policy keeps their earning potential strong and predictable.
HB 4002 introduces more flexibility for earned paid sick leave. It exempts small businesses with fewer than 50 employees from certain accrual requirements while giving workers access to their full sick time at the start of the year. These thoughtful adjustments protect jobs, make policies more worker-friendly, and allow businesses to better plan for the future.
We commend Rep. Schuette and his committee for their dedication to Michigan’s workforce and applaud Speaker Matt Hall for making this issue a priority. Their leadership ensures a fair balance between supporting employees and enabling businesses to thrive.
Now, it’s time for the Senate to act. We urge Senator Brinks to bring these bills up for a vote promptly so we can safeguard jobs, protect workers, and preserve Michigan’s proud small business community.

---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
| Senator Roger Hauck Senator Mark Huizenga

##
Week 1 in a new White House...
I took this picture on of day 1 of the first Trump administration getting settled in my new office in the West Wing with the team. As you can see it was pretty bare.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d80bcf93-8509-4475-a2cb-e09e555b1b2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Day 1 in the White House is choatic. There's a lot of moving parts. You are learning how to get around, set up electronics, and in our case meet for the first time many of your new colleagues.
I have more behind the scenes pictures if you are interested below.
Beyond the photos, I can't help but think of what a different Day One and Week One that the Trump 2.0 Team is having. It really is night and day.
Simply put they are crushing it. I feel like every time I walk away from the tv I'm going to miss something. Even the biggest Trump hater has to admit he is following through on what he promised to do as a candidate (imagine that).
While our day one was spent settling in, getting our badges, getting oriented etc, it was clear they had done a ton of prep work. Having been there once before (including much of the staff), is a HUGE advantage (BTW, despite only having 48 to adjust the inauguration it came off flawless --\- I dare say better).
On my day one I think I was allowed to bring 4 maybe 5 of the total staff on board. Clearly this wa not the case this time. They had many more employees ready to go...

As we stare down another term of Donald Trump’s assault on our norms, laws, and institutions, let’s talk about how we _win_ the fight for fair electoral maps and leadership that more fairly represents the will of the voters. While very few people are paying attention, crucial decisions are being made in state redistricting commissions, courtrooms, and state-level elections that will help determine who holds power in this Here’s just a snapshot of the key elections, legal battles, and redistricting efforts we’re tracking in 2025:
1. **Fighting for fair congressional maps** in states like Ohio and Texas to level the playing field in the U.S. House of Representatives so Democrats have a fair shot to take back control and put a check on Trump’s power.
2. **Electing pro-democracy champions** to state-level offices where they can slow down or stop the MAGA agenda.
3. **Protecting the upcoming U.S. Census** to ensure undercounted and underrepresented communities do not end up with less representation in Congress and less political power — and fair maps progress isn’t rolled back.
4. **Defending Black opportunity districts** in Alabama, Georgia, Florida, and Louisiana.

As we stare down another term of Donald Trump’s assault on our norms, laws, and institutions, let’s talk about how we win the fight for fair electoral maps and leadership that more fairly represents the will of the voters. While very few people are paying attention, crucial decisions are being made in state redistricting commissions, courtrooms, and state-level elections that will help determine who holds power in this country for years to come. We have to be the ones paying attention.= Gerrymandered maps have played a decisive role in countless elections at the state and federal levels, creating an artificial advantage for Republicans that has contributed to their wins in November and prior elections. # FROM THE DESK OF LARRY KUDLOW
---
| | Reader,**I am pleased to share with you that The New York Sun, one of my daily must-read papers, is now the exclusive publisher of my regular columns.

I invite you to consider joining the Sun to receive unlimited access to my latest commentary, alongside some of the finest American journalism.

**But there's also far more to what the Sun is building.

As you know, journalism isn't what it used to be.

I've been in the business for decades, and never before have I seen this once noble profession so abused. The major papers are no longer on the side of the American people, and we are right to withhold our trust.

The impact on our democracy is considerable. Without real accountability, the worst actors in government and at corporate institutions have free reign, and patriotic, hard-working Americans are being sidelined and ignored.

The antidote is to join the movement to build a better alternative. That's the American way.

**The charge to restore American journalism is being led by the Sun.** A proudly all-American, principled publication that has plenty of room for conservative thought and conservative writers, the Sun has upheld the highest journalistic standards since 1833. That's 18 years before the New York Times published its first number.**My decision for the New York Sun to become the exclusive publisher of my regular columns was not taken lightly.**

I value their work and have been impressed by their team, but I know they have a hell of a battle ahead. They are the David facing many Goliaths.

body:
10 surprising questions about heaven
Imagine you’re planning a move to a new country
| | | [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=774ede14d8e14e6f8351b02917537748&_e=rdhHXJI9xM_eiwz54qqotcfG6UQrhnDhzyOCn4rGU3WrU1p5IFQepRNyaCOYEWL9q9jrKlKQs8tNDZns_gPtJAhuDuWw31geaWpihru2r91vih-kyGyotYYZ1q9Ordg7qHfZ3JZJ_ldr6CDCm3F9ruThh4VnLZO2DK81hBCEa1kalI7F4-zN-Eca5CVdK2hTYzpEUJJpkOcsS5ipPEwYqXBKR7x5jrB5vJbW_whHon_hjm92exfqA72uIkbyada42ZsHVZLmNcQ7NaLUO_sfrOBLbCP74EnZkA4JDm_cBK-y5EDzUvBW50PL2eJpZh5yRYstbxcJOFBjLIYQkbG_tnDb8nu_cBHrQKxFfJ_lUmD6tF7WKKiugUHI31HHgAnFiVzS4wzWZvzNU-NjsfDorZaY98m3IjmzgOP7uW9Xfw8%3D)
---
Peter,

Imagine you're planning a move to a new country--a faraway place you've never visited before. Wouldn't you want to know everything you could about it--what the culture is like, the language, the climate, and most importantly, how to get there? It would make a huge difference in how you prepare for the journey!

As Christians, we know that one day we will leave this world and be united with God in heaven. But surprisingly, many of us know very little about what awaits us in that incredible place.
---
| | In my book _A Place Called Heaven_ , I dive into Scripture to answer 10 surprising questions about heaven, including:

* Is heaven a real place or just a state of mind?
* Will we know our loved ones when we get there?
* Do people in heaven know what's happening on earth?
* What difference does a future heaven make in our lives today?

---
| [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=774ede14d8e14e6f8351b02917537748&_e=rdhHXJI9xM_eiwz54qqotcfG6UQrhnDhzyOCn4rGU3WrU1p5IFQepRNyaCOYEWL9q9jrKlKQs8tNDZns_gPtJAhuDuWw31geaWpihru2r91vih-kyGyotYYZ1q9Ordg7qHfZ3JZJ_ldr6CDCm3F9ruThh4VnLZO2DK81hBCEa1kalI7F4-zN-Eca5CVdK2hTYzpEUJJpkOcsS5ipPEwYqXBKR7x5jrB5vJbW_whHon_hjm92exfqA72uIkbyada4LDyQjQPRvUJFObYBSqUl32TKaaC2mmKpR3G4my6EsWiubNmNbXJzRSEjV5g9rdygLuhxj9Dboh9LiZS_KL5570XbLNDNEApDfEkOCHHXbok_KNW2P2_dDyPTHS7dWxjmkcRulqmN53sNzYms59VWFjpgkQpWdRRu7fuGWUKRCVs%3D)
---
| | I know many of us have asked these questions at some point. Understanding what the Bible says about our eternal home doesn't just satisfy our curiosity--it transforms how we live today. By shifting our focus from the temporary struggles of this life to the eternal glory that awaits us, we can live with greater hope, purpose, and peace.

To thank you for your generous gift to _Pathway to Victory_ today, I'd love to send you a copy of _A Place Called Heaven_ , [https://secure.ptv.org/a-place-called-heaven-generous-gift-1](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=774ede14d8e14e6f8351b02917537748&_e=rdhHXJI9xM_eiwz54qqotcfG6UQrhnDhzyOCn4rGU3WrU1p5IFQepRNyaCOYEWL9q9jrKlKQs8tNDZns_gPtJAhuDuWw31geaWpihru2r91vih-kyGyotYYZ1q9Ordg7qHfZ3JZJ_ldr6CDCm3F9ruThh4VnLZO2DK81hBCEa1kalI7F4-zN-Eca5CVdK2hTYzpEUJJpkOcsS5ipPEwYqXBKR7x5jrB5vJbW_whHon_hjm92exfqA72uIkbyada4AgpA7oDTYQn_bBQIL1qNLaeXELFQwvbSrlzH0eJczf3Wp2RJQ7qICrYBqwc3CFs6e9kjAiIVTv0cRW8g2o8gXAKsJn9_0DiX6ExN0VRrD2m5aBfu2yvW6Ujx-t9toiomDpwHts2fjgdgpBGyzw8GnYT-Nj5V2yVX91u0r4JXc9c%3D)

I hope this book will give you a clearer picture of the future God has prepared for you and help you live each day with eternity in mind.

Thank you for your continued support, which helps us spread the gospel of Jesus Christ to a world in need of hope.

Thank you for standing with us and sharing the gospel of Jesus Christ.

Sincerely,

Dr. Robert Jeffress

subject: What a difference!
body:
History was made | | | [](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6793e6fb78e2320edf236fa7&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftombarrettforcongress.com%2F%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D6793c291babf6678abc235d5%26ss_email_id%3D6793e6fb78e2320edf236fa7%26ss_campaign_name%3DWhat%2Ba%2Bdifference%2521%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2025-01-24T19%253A16%253A15Z&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_6793c291babf6678abc235d5&l=en-US&s=qLpkXcaVbslmfVAE9Xp5YN3zP00%3D)
---
| What a difference!On Monday, I stood in the Capitol Rotunda to watch President Trump take the Oath of Office and announce an America First agenda that will get America moving forward again.
---
| [](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6793e6fb78e2320edf236fa7&u=https%3A%2F%2Fyoutube.com%2Fshorts%2FfqCsCOlF5bE&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_6793c291babf6678abc235d5&l=en-US&s=bIXHbBLPs6UEVQ7MrDvPR0DWvMU%3D)
---
And President Trump wasted no time turning back the failed policies of the Biden Administration - issuing more than 200 Executive Orders designed to get our economy moving again, developing domestic energy sources, and securing our borders!
---
[_ _ Support Tom _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6793e6fb78e2320edf236fa7&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Fprotect-americas-borders&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_6793c291babf6678abc235d5&l=en-US&s=6xIqsvrXy_VHFBfDHraOrs-BK3M%3D)
---
The Trump Administration immediately declared the Southern Border a “National Emergency,” terminated the Biden “CPB One” asylum app, authorized the continued construction of the US-Mexico border wall, and declared the cartels “Foreign Terrorist Organizations.”Not only that, President Trump has sent thousands of American troops to the border to help state and federal officials protect our sovereignty.
---
[_ _ Protect Our Border _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6793e6fb78e2320edf236fa7&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Fprotect-americas-borders&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_6793c291babf6678abc235d5&l=en-US&s=6xIqsvrXy_VHFBfDHraOrs-BK3M%3D)
---
This week, I was proud to vote for the Laken Riley Act, the first bill President Trump will sign in the Oval Office.The Laken Riley Act will make it easier for immigration officials to detain and deport illegal immigrants who are charged with a crime. When a person who comes here illegally breaks additional laws, there is no reason they should be allowed to walk our streets and put Americans at risk.The Revolution of Common Sense that President Trump promised in his inaugural speech has begun!
---
[_ _ Finish the Job _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6793e6fb78e2320edf236fa7&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Fprotect-americas-borders&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_6793c291babf6678abc235d5&l=en-US&s=6xIqsvrXy_VHFBfDHraOrs-BK3M%3D)
---
We have a tough fight ahead of us. President Trump has nominated a historic group to his cabinet - outsiders who are committed to an America First agenda - to root out the waste, fraud, and abuse within our government and get back to serving the American people.It is why I ran for Congress and what I am committed to doing. And we’ve only just begun.
---
I am proud to be here in Washington fighting for my district, my state, and my nation. I appreciate your support!
---
|

Derek —
My heart continues to break for the people of Southern California impacted by the fires.
There are no words to fully express the devastation — Derek, you've seen the headlines and heard the tragic stories of lives lost, families evacuated, homes burned down, and memories destroyed.
As firefighters continue to work to contain the damage, communities in Southern California still need our help.
The Red Cross of Los Angeles County has been incredibly hard at work. More than 200 American Red Cross workers, many of whom have been affected by these wildfires themselves, are helping residents of Southern California whom the wildfires have displaced. The Red Cross is providing shelter, food, and relief supplies to people affected by the California wildfires.
**[If you are able to, please donate directly to the Red Cross of Los Angeles County by going here to this donation page.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/5113?t=4&akid=8269%2E5257348%2Euchw4b)**
[DONATE NOW](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/5113?t=5&akid=8269%2E5257348%2Euchw4b)
---
I’m already looking ahead to how we can ensure every person impacted is set up for success on their path to rebuilding.
I’ll be working with my colleagues across the aisle to make sure people in Southern California have the resources they need to return home safely and restart their lives with some sense of normalcy.
It won’t be easy. But our team is strong, and Californians are resilient. We must find strength in one another.
**[Please chip in any amount you can spare to directly support the Red Cross of Los Angeles County.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/5113?t=6&akid=8269%2E5257348%2Euchw4b)**

name: Elissa Slotkin

body:
Last week, I had the opportunity to question President Trump's nominee to become director of that agency, Russell Vought.
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2232%2E135344%2ES0xpT-)

The Office of Management and Budget is a huge job that a lot of people have never heard of. It’s responsible for, among other things, preparing the budget the President of the United States presents to Congress. Big stuff. Think of them as the ones who dispense all the money of the federal government.
Last week, I had the opportunity to question President Trump's nominee to become director of that agency, Russell Vought.
He had the same job in the first administration and when he was there he submitted three straight budgets that zeroed out funding for the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative -- a huge program that maintains the Great Lakes, which account for about 20% of the fresh water in the world. I asked him about that, and I asked him whether or not the president's priorities trump the U.S. Constitution and whether he would abide by the Constitution and current laws, not laws he or the president wish were on the books.
You can watch the questions here -- it's short.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/3619?t=2&akid=2232%2E135344%2ES0xpT-)
As a Democratic Senator elected on the same ticket as President Trump, I respect that Mr. Vought and I will disagree on policy — but there shouldn’t be any flexibility around respecting the Constitution. His demonstrated record of disregard for the rule of law should disqualify him from any position of public trust, much less the powerful Director of Office of Management and Budget.
Regardless of my view of any nominee, I will always roll up my sleeves, find common ground and work with anyone who is serious about getting things done for Michigan.
Thank you for reading and watching,
Elissa
* * *

clean_body: Last week, I had the opportunity to question President Trump's nominee to become director of that agency, Russell Vought. - The Office of Management and Budget is a huge job that a lot of people have never heard of. It’s responsible for, among other things, preparing the budget the President of the United States presents to Congress. Big stuff. Think of them as the ones who dispense all the money of the federal government. Last week, I had the opportunity to question President Trump's nominee to become director of that agency, Russell Vought. He had the same job in the first administration and when he was there he submitted three straight budgets that zeroed out funding for the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative -- a huge program that maintains the Great Lakes, which account for about 20% of the fresh water in the world. I asked him about that, and I asked him whether or not the president's priorities trump the U.S. Constitution and whether he would abide by the Constitution and current laws, not laws he or the president wish were on the books. You can watch the questions here -- it's short. - As a Democratic Senator elected on the same ticket as President Trump, I respect that Mr. Vought and I will disagree on policy — but there shouldn’t be any flexibility around respecting the Constitution. One of the key parts of my agenda for this legislative session is tackling economic growth. **Earlier this month, we announced our Economic Growth Agenda**. This proposal is about more than just money; it is about strategy.
* First, we need to cut red tape to make it easier to start a business and grow our economy.
* Second, we need to focus on life sciences, I.T., and aerospace and defense — areas where Maryland can win.
* Third, we need to improve coordination and partnership.

This strategy prioritizes investments in the areas of our state that drive the most growth. This strategy will help create good-paying jobs, and make it easier for businesses to choose Maryland, grow, and stay in Maryland. **This is the blueprint for the next year, and I’m looking forward to seeing how we can continue making this Maryland’s decade.** Elevate, Wes

Simon Hankinson is a Senior Research Fellow in the Border Security and Immigration Center at The Heritage Foundation.

>From 1999–2022, he was a Foreign Service Officer serving in India, Fiji, Ghana, Slovakia, Togo, Washington, D.C., Marseille, and Nairobi. Prior to entering the State Department, Hankinson worked as a lawyer in London, and then taught history, English, and drama at a private school in Miami.

subject: The Need For Property Tax Reform!
body:
As your state legislator, I understand the need to fix our property tax system.

# The Need for Property Tax Reform
---
|
---
| This week, I was thankful for the opportunity to be in our nation’s capital for the inauguration of our 47th president Donald J Trump. While I was there I had the honor to meet with many patriots and Hoosiers alike. I look forward to the work that’ll be accomplished here the next 4 years!
---
|
---
| To follow up from last week though, I wanted to cover the pressing issue of property taxes and what I have heard from constituents time and time again all over the district. Because of this I wrote an article for the Indianapolis Business Journal talking about my proposed plan in the legislature and the need to tackle the issue this session. Here are my thoughts and I will also be happy to link my bill that I currently proposed below.
---
| [House Bill 1075 Property Taxes](https://hoosiersforhaggard.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9e7cbafb97c2110b065cece3&id=52fa8d8815&e=72dace1453)

name: Mark Kelly
subject: The Senate votes on Pete Hegseth today. My thoughts…
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
It is my responsibility to ensure that the Secretary of Defense can meet the demands of the job. I don’t think that Pete Hegseth can.
#

Hey everybody, it’s Mark Kelly here.
The United States Senate is scheduled to vote on Pete Hegseth’s nomination as Secretary of Defense later today. I will be voting against him. Please, let me explain why:
The Secretary of Defense needs to walk into the job ready and able to command the largest bureaucracy in the United States. They must have the necessary experience to lead 3.4 million uniformed and civilian employees in the defense of our nation. And they must possess the strength of character to live up to the enormous responsibilities of the job.
This is one of the toughest, most important posts there is. It is my responsibility to ensure that the Secretary of Defense can meet the demands of the job, and I don’t think that Pete Hegseth can.
My colleagues and I pressed Hegseth on his qualifications over the course of his hearing. His answers did not inspire confidence.
Hegseth has admitted to personal issues in his past. When I asked about those same issues, he blamed an “anonymous smear” campaign against him. It can’t be both.
Hegseth denied allegations of misconduct throughout the hearing. I asked if any of those answers would be different if he was under oath, and he refused to answer that question.
In spite of all of that, Hegseth may be confirmed. I can understand if that’s difficult to hear.
Here’s the truth, though: This process does not end with one cabinet members’ confirmation. It is more important than ever that we hold President Trump’s administration accountable. Arizona sent me to the Senate to serve on their behalf, and I don’t intend to let them down.
I will not back down. I am not going anywhere. And I am going to stand firm against any efforts to undermine our military and degrade our national security — whether they come from Hegseth, President Trump, or anyone else.
I hope you’re with me on that.
Thanks for reading,
Mark

Friend, This week, fires still burned in California while the rest of the country was plunged into extremely cold temperatures. These disasters are intensified and fueled by climate change, and they’ll keep coming unless we take on the biggest contributor to climate change: the fossil fuel industry. Unfortunately, Trump’s first actions in Congress included capitulating to fossil fuel executives and trying to expand fossil fuel extraction. This is the opposite of what we need, and **it’s time to get louder in the fight for our planet and for our communities’ safety.** In the last congressional session, I joined Senator Ed Markey and Representative Ayanna Pressley to re-introduce the _Fossil Free Finance Act_ , which would require the Federal Reserve to make major banks stop financing fossil fuel projects and deforestation. Financial institutions under the Federal Reserve’s supervision provide trillions of dollars in direct fossil fuel financing, and the Federal Reserve has the responsibility and power to address the financial risks posed by climate change—at the scale this crisis demands. [**Will you sign on today to demand Congress and the Federal Reserve act to address the root causes of the climate crisis, including by requiring big banks to stop funding fossil fuels?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm381rcfdHkIQD_K7aziRYYN5uI0h55AeNqJGQhL6CI4WFcvPfiSS1BrbynjNQrU0OyywE4SYMk8ii0LVxdD1apGotdeGP9lsOkUP6HSt7Cp2Ic1kG-kKLLzycDVlsE_H41VcW0v05hNnk5e1pU6kYEbz265GJoOX_42c2Kv2n3YfGs_lR8bgUbJS4UCMpYefLUGt20TKn9ZiN40fdFIvaNwT40NtNIx_w1rDJuOR1mmqqmYCs6NzzFOZS1rnFtQ5IRFvPrYWJ9MO-EA_IDeKn8391QWGqmBbHYFb-2lvQB8pF98U17yW-dfkd1cYsvlQgntIEVaGAxsycXhf6ERE5O0kuJn2m3CVHsdol22E_2xd7DyjND2kfxeyRPQBFK0NI647EARV55ttGipJeJnefCg-uLCT4dZetq_kc0UHwolfIA/4df/hXLAB8zxTXyM8sOH9vONAQ/h1/h001.81ioU8x6Tgiq4o7IinUDOHrnRWpQJuDny6UKjLtXNUY) Together we will continue fighting for environmental justice. In solidarity, Rashida \---------- Forwarded message ---------

Subject: Weather extremes are connected by climate change
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Friend, Fires in Los Angeles are still burning, while most of the rest of the country is experiencing frigid temperatures, including record-breaking snowstorms in the deep South. My city of Detroit is used to the cold, but temperatures got so extreme that hundreds of schools closed and pipes burst, leading to water main breaks all over the city that flooded and then froze streets. All of these weather extremes are connected: They’re all intensified and caused by climate change. And the largest contributor to climate change is the fossil fuel industry. Instead of addressing this crisis that’s dangerous for all of our communities, Trump’s first actions in the White House included steps to make it worse. **Now more than ever, we need bold policies to help address the root causes of climate change and help our communities better prepare for the climate-fueled disasters to come.** For example, in the last congressional session, I joined Representative Ayanna Pressley to re-introduce the _Fossil Free Finance Act_ in the U.S. House of Representatives, in coordination with Senator Ed Markey in the Senate. This legislation would require major banks to stop financing fossil fuel projects and deforestation. On his first day in the White House Trump took steps to: withdraw from the Paris climate accords and other pacts that have aimed to reduce emissions, declare a mostly-symbolic “energy emergency” to try to push for even more fossil fuel extraction (while threatening to block renewable energy), and undo protections for Alaska’s wilderness to encourage more fossil fuel production.
**Our communities don’t have time to wait. With Trump cozying up to fossil fuel executives, it’s time to ramp up our demands rather than back down.**
It’s time for policies like the _Fossil Free Finance Act,_ which directs the Federal Reserve to act on its responsibility to protect financial stability and finally address the financial risks posed by climate change—at the scale this crisis demands. Financial institutions under the Federal Reserve’s supervision provide trillions of dollars in direct fossil fuel financing, so targeting these big players is a critical way to make change happen quickly.
[**Please add your name to demand bold climate action from the U.S. government, including pushing the Federal Reserve to make big banks stop financing fossil fuels and deforestation.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm381rcfdHkIQD_K7aziRYYN5uI0h55AeNqJGQhL6CI4WFcvPfiSS1BrbynjNQrU0OyywE4SYMk8ii0LVxdD1apGotdeGP9lsOkUP6HSt7Cp2Ic1kG-kKLLzycDVlsE_H41Vcaq6wZPZFH4yOH3Z6dKpGcmTgih4HdzhjUhZu87xLVtEbmI8IEK2Vkk_jS9k8WuX4rqHR71iZzV4NnfXdRSdrzgr-v859Uox5R6Zk-O30AvS9cyOU8MrM65nJVLx1JLmPg1tLWgiL2yLe1qMxWt1xKXrBFbBH8iBDw_qysXyJW9I2HlKDlq0RMUo2s1LwhoehbPz5ed2THb7Un89WHbLVm-GmQnp3oayXg1QRMmObRl6Fe-7C2zthGuvImG3LCaVNXm2PEULMnM6O4FmINmB3H52YplsD-A4ltVdEKs_rIg/4df/hXLAB8zxTXyM8sOH9vONAQ/h4/h001.OppzBw3p1BINGioJVMP9LKhyfRnnSjshux1yxZsRLxg)
Thank you for continuing to push for the changes our communities need and deserve.
I will continue being your voice in Congress, where I will resist the Trump administration’s attacks on our environment, our immigrant neighbors, trans and queer people, programs like Social Security and Medicare, and our rights. name: Ilhan Omar
subject: I will never forget the fear that we felt when the far-right mob stormed the building
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
It’s unacceptable that President Trump is pardoning those responsible for January 6th
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1464%2E791427%2EZL1m0o)

Friend — I want to follow up on my recent updates on Trump’s first actions as president.
You may have seen this in the news already, but I thought it would be important to talk about this: **Trump has pardoned or commuted the sentences of over 1,500 people charged with crimes from the insurrection at the Capitol on January 6th.**
I was at the Capitol that day, and I will never forget the fear that we felt when we learned that a far-right mob had stormed the building. I will never forget the call I made to the father of my children, asking him to tell my children I loved them in case I couldn't.
Now the people who attacked our Capitol are free of the consequences of their crimes — many of whom are leaders or members of avowed white nationalist and extremist groups.
But Friend , January 6th was not solely significant for the havoc that it caused, the property destroyed, or the lives it cost. January 6th was significant because it was an attack on the seat of our democracy. An attempted coup, specifically designed to overturn the most fundamental of democratic processes — a nationwide election — on the day its results were to be certified.

Hi folks, it’s Oregon Secretary of State Tobias Read.
Last month, my team sent you a survey inquiring about your priorities for the year ahead.
I was grateful to see hundreds of replies in just a few days, so I wanted to thank those who took the time to share your thoughts with me! Your responses are invaluable as we set our agenda for 2025.
But now I have one more request: Can you contribute any amount to help defend Oregon’s democracy and safeguard our for-the-people agenda? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=240124em-responses]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=240124em-responses]
It’s clear from your responses that Oregonians are eager for the government to deliver over the next year. The top responses to our grassroots priorities survey included:
→ Tackling misinformation,
→ Lowering the cost of housing
→ Defending reproductive rights
I can’t wait to rebuild the trust in our state government, which will be necessary to achieve these and other key priorities this year and beyond.
And if you’re proud to be on my team as we get to work in 2025, I’d be so grateful if you could show your support by chipping in $5, $10, or more right now. >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=240124em-responses]
Thank you,
Tobias Read

subject: ✉️ Congress needs to hear from you. How to protect immigrant communities today:
body:
We take care of each other — one action you can take today to defend our community: | | | Hey Peter, 🥱 It’s been a long week for immigrant communities across the country, but we’re not letting Trump’s chaos drive us into the shadows! We’re caring for one another, sharing the resources our loved ones need, and taking action together to build a future where we can all live in safety and dignity. [**Fight back with us — you can take action right now by demanding permanent protections for immigrant communities!**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39bSHPEVdTvmkLrxcou61Oo-YGW5QOlxLyar2wPlbLzkvYQtc9LF8N9j33cc7VvDEFRfMzG5X11WL1_YC8-2PVfHy9smwczhsfCUSOnKIBmK5yC7TJ60OBrnEBnsm3s0D6W7S-vFe2o8x9aADfwcPBxlJ-fq5d0NAfmKXvmEvOr2H6hziIKXjyx3nUluvm4nfYlVtImZ7cAHAJ5bB_ez0vRhUq2q-g4_C5cqRGYDgA5Y968oI98eEwz2aYe2mYy6X0QwWefrBiuXvkAF5O_TML-1DE9u4oEv-vnUuimcv_XoT7qagvZC-JHY14SPgsL9QSjbWZnA3n7KcbThC-H7Ejgvpqqt_Mm9wurKAbnCx6vTA/4df/giIoXYJ6TYe-iKxad1eNgA/h0/h001.UE1FdslMnXeWGUiWVJLJWVgST76PX8G7pg9M7KIq0O0) Let’s get you caught up. In a snapshot:
* 🧑⚖️ **The Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals ruled against DACA on Friday afternoon** , keeping renewals open for now.

* ❌ **Congress passed Senate Bill S.5** , a harmful bill that will put our neighbors, co-workers, and loved ones in danger of racial profiling and inhumane and indefinite detention.

* ✍️ **On Monday, Trump was officially inaugurated into office** , kicking off his administration by announcing a slate of harmful anti-immigrant Executive Orders. He pledged to unleash the military against families seeking safety at the border, attacked birthright citizenship for children of immigrants, and promised to ramp up mass deportations in dozens of cities across the country, like Chicago, LA, and Austin.

* **🤝 Yesterday, we did what our community does best: We came together at our national community call to protect one another, organize, and strategize key ways to have each other’s backs.** Trump’s attacks don’t scare us — our communities are stronger than his fear tactics, and we’re ready to defend each other no matter what.

With the future of DACA in danger and millions of immigrant families at risk of being separated by Trump’s crusade against our communities,**** we must pressure Congress to deliver permanent protections for all. **Congress must take action NOW to deliver a pathway to citizenship for millions of individuals, including DACA recipients, who risk being torn from their families and communities.** Can you join me in taking action? Send a letter to your members of Congress today! **[Send a Letter](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39bSHPEVdTvmkLrxcou61Oo-YGW5QOlxLyar2wPlbLzkvYQtc9LF8N9j33cc7VvDEFRfMzG5X11WL1_YC8-2PVfHy9smwczhsfCUSOnKIBmK5yC7TJ60OBrnEBnsm3s0D6W7S-vFe2o8x9aADfwcPBx9UTpYh4-LvSofKS5EK0e9SX8ROGVwx4LblogAVteuLyMtSWHf0068fZtrOEi2sSgtlZf3EitbAR1k_nlrWOXBhVUUtlji0rCnT94JVHA3Y9l9IG8db2_szFA6RSo9KDxAEV5fw6EgbkUsEozfEDspyWBYIn2BRKrCYO8GGrYtRHtafXLtFIBY_k8K0sXUQ3HEPn5ZkIB-joHE_V5fB5Z8g/4df/giIoXYJ6TYe-iKxad1eNgA/h1/h001.wBLmfSFA04Nkf3HOURX1eCyzkvS_yhsaIa0nn5YhUjs)** [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39bSHPEVdTvmkLrxcou61Oo-YGW5QOlxLyar2wPlbLzkvYQtc9LF8N9j33cc7VvDEFRfMzG5X11WL1_YC8-2PVfHy9smwczhsfCUSOnKIBmK5yC7TJ60OBrnEBnsm3s0D6W7S-vFe2o8x9aADfwcPBxEtAWLuFxywmlBDDoVv6K9I_GCC-gu8dv6TeVqsxAa6qFavY8JHd5eVprZi4-kfm41oXjKvkhq_FHa3XEGIr_xozy6pL0KM-MpLl_9GixRDVrLThE1-nL3qq8sQGBtA5yno2rGYodhLxrfX5bA4fBM9W3Xr3oWVKEUfVSLzRZANMSSHzSZnaMdlbA6lhi8hMp3wOkqkKalbI1iIBCgPU9AA/4df/giIoXYJ6TYe-iKxad1eNgA/h2/h001.rN13rrWjljNEwoDbihFdrb_U4tOJxyP0-XyFhIhNywE)
Peter, mass deportations impact all of us and would hurt many of the people we know, spend time with, and care about. **[People's lives are on the line, and Congress must do their part to deliver the only real solution: a pathway to citizenship for all!](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39bSHPEVdTvmkLrxcou61Oo-YGW5QOlxLyar2wPlbLzkvYQtc9LF8N9j33cc7VvDEFRfMzG5X11WL1_YC8-2PVfHy9smwczhsfCUSOnKIBmK5yC7TJ60OBrnEBnsm3s0D6W7S-vFe2o8x9aADfwcPBxnVQlmMBNgzz1l02uxk3YeceAa68NByZQqWS8ctzy-4Ccrjn8bwAoJTXXCUZG4fYG3C_PIfO3HpNdxVwBJ4juv_DvN40547CAVfa022EZH7KkNq761Tpr_f2n84h9etMDCci2UI-BUtIkKwiI7Awcz4t9w3xtqNqt6NDyl8JPa82BtMvWNba5dfjyoktdVgCyTXl911cWhviZcr-BY-L7Rw/4df/giIoXYJ6TYe-iKxad1eNgA/h3/h001.a_VVIdM_JfEyKIl9V9PW0oICIsPZc2KDyJX9fMeGjJ0)** In community, Carolina and the United We Dream team P.S.: With Trump back in office, we’ll need to rely on one another to keep our communities and families safe. 👉 **[Join our Here to Stay Network today to be the first to hear about real ways you can take action in your day-to-day life to fight back against family separation and deportations!](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.v2UrIOJHHKkg0Pk-aGvhyzCKAdQv6ANAIbZ_2K5v_dC91rsipD286ESFr9EvsYLUJig4VkQHgcNi6qJi15c52bQFaFDNN6tbblBHnb98yhAHB71PvgGT0SZMoRrBv9nZ5pD_xbhp4v9w4AWIKa50npe0HR2w8r72Ro09K1X-YkwxIbVRfkywoY-d_iiDdE3PB8KUXhEMKFqlj5NJ3lZILkvnyYzt0BTBNsJLitzrSSMWs0IE2ufS3JvHjgazKXBLMFwlO_EpUZkSWMiTOcfjHO0ODMeiVJBR4XpXzEpuDm2W1fM7R8j_mFuIZIfrU62_NaoW9eR_KLuvSC5WQmDwXA/4df/giIoXYJ6TYe-iKxad1eNgA/h4/h001.6NSHDG4XydKfLw0IJt604kRwL4vmqVNF4xLlMJWfeik) **

clean_body: We take care of each other — one action you can take today to defend our community: | | | Hey Peter, 🥱 It’s been a long week for immigrant communities across the country, but we’re not letting Trump’s chaos drive us into the shadows! We’re caring for one another, sharing the resources our loved ones need, and taking action together to build a future where we can all live in safety and dignity. Let’s get you caught up. In a snapshot: 🧑⚖️ The Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals ruled against DACA on Friday afternoon , keeping renewals open for now. ❌ Congress passed Senate Bill S.5 , a harmful bill that will put our neighbors, co-workers, and loved ones in danger of racial profiling and inhumane and indefinite detention. ✍️ On Monday, Trump was officially inaugurated into office , kicking off his administration by announcing a slate of harmful anti-immigrant Executive Orders. He pledged to unleash the military against families seeking safety at the border, attacked birthright citizenship for children of immigrants, and promised to ramp up mass deportations in dozens of cities across the country, like Chicago, LA, and Austin. 🤝 Yesterday, we did what our community does best: We came together at our national community call to protect one another, organize, and strategize key ways to have each other’s backs. Trump’s attacks don’t scare us — our communities are stronger than his fear tactics, and we’re ready to defend each other no matter what. With the future of DACA in danger and millions of immigrant families at risk of being separated by Trump’s crusade against our communities,** we must pressure Congress to deliver permanent protections for all. Congress must take action NOW to deliver a pathway to citizenship for millions of individuals, including DACA recipients, who risk being torn from their families and communities. Can you join me in taking action? Send a letter to your members of Congress today! Peter, mass deportations impact all of us and would hurt many of the people we know, spend time with, and care about. In community, Carolina and the United We Dream team P.S.: With Trump back in office, we’ll need to rely on one another to keep our communities and families safe. 👉 ** | Follow us on: | | | | |

name: David Horowitz
subject: I’m not saying this to scare you
body:
I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever.| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=5c06a056b1b84f329decd394204356d2&_e=LkSfxtoe5SvZz1F0AxhCGfVgTVuxlOdOgP9LACoZt1Ip5STnrhZWGRPPa_xih17ISiaWG3qh54on76WItxS_aVtf28E4j278lxkGgSqcF0rRcyf4UPMxpbwfDJLAkOhbolmOhGLieiNUsl2bVKsCKKQDPm1KgPdYph7ANXDghOR-Z8fGmb4DE6XmdNAtuNY0x1MuE6A9ObylWjS0ktws02y5c34rx5yYcfE7tYV-OqvjmJFz91WaAO_gX-5hPte2X6D0_Q1CfW7TYYvsD42GVRMdzW38abq9jsiOMHqrjHr12T4uRwRd9K9gE_YVmh7QbIi0KO8kiQDBwN7uT6zwhgTkWdrFA3dwArTp5cdOSOdDdXImqijQN_rlZxBPCC7WFzidw_3Csd7qdLQFU-kIRQ%3D%3D)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=5c06a056b1b84f329decd394204356d2&_e=LkSfxtoe5SvZz1F0AxhCGfVgTVuxlOdOgP9LACoZt1Ip5STnrhZWGRPPa_xih17ISiaWG3qh54on76WItxS_aVtf28E4j278lxkGgSqcF0rRcyf4UPMxpbwfDJLAkOhbolmOhGLieiNUsl2bVKsCKKQDPm1KgPdYph7ANXDghOR-Z8fGmb4DE6XmdNAtuNY0x1MuE6A9ObylWjS0ktws02y5c34rx5yYcfE7tYV-OqvjmJFz91WaAO_gX-5hPte2-MndWghNJVMvrQGL8DMZFv-8qsiK7ka77Jpv10aGdgBKstBLudqCMvx-Z8dgOa7ma46ho7TGs1JGTgVwayMMIrtd7sTU6OHYxjfBmV28pYVcg8b3lFbfTMyglkqHZnwttCHRU5gqUoTIuDJA3Cuhfw%3D%3D)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.

David Horowitz

## Basketball Player Saves Opponent's Life
A high school basketball game in Oklahoma turned into [a life-saving event](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kLEOpCAURb8GOwy8AR0Lim3sZtstDcJD2HmKEVbj329mkm23PSe5yT2_XtPLJkrb8tOuaMISphryBAI0F5KDmrxNdE-q8SYgAj4aNLJ_9L0WHegmGglPRBEcKj37oFw_dzBLPXS6RxBDaJL5rAkJCgT0WrXWPb0GOQjUznXDwJRAn2o-2t85bTVioDufeLQurw2ZWOte2OMHg5HBeF1Xu81uw6t8PINxS0usdPMPYjCeyWNmMOY32ZhXy2NaIi8u5kx8tuWNdbZEfCd748GLPbHwvO-5pG3hFe36T9lQ8eARuctEdi_oed54_YI_R-UAQzdI1UmtdXMYv1-JKJWuZ0osq030PVD_F_U08DcAAP__qV199Q) when 18-year-old Magnus Miller saved the life of Randy Vitales, a 16-year-old player on the opposing team. [Vitales collapsed](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx80LFyhCAQxvGnwU4HV5RYUKSxu7QpnQ0sugkKA-Scy9NnLg-Q6ut-883__bbekAOf2xseZPzm1-rjChLGVvYtqNUhh8eqGmc8EdDQkOn1oPUoJxib3Winxg-PHmZQckLAiSzoAfxAakAnGzZPTfagQIIeVYf2xY3Qz5JGa6d5FkqS4xpz9xn5rDv58Ih3yp2NRxPMXmsqYngVsAhYruvqvvjcPJedcspUSndSFbBgrmwDCVhKirkWAYt7Mm2JaY9HzNTusSSuGPiHXIu-Um5tDAFT4XNr3Xd-zoYHNdm4dHEIXCYtlNwO5PD3p_7X6G7gNwAA__8pwG6D) from cardiac arrest just three minutes into the game. Miller, a trained lifeguard, immediately sprang into action, using an automated external defibrillator (AED) to restore Vitales' heartbeat and coordinating CPR efforts until paramedics arrived. "_Without a shadow of a doubt, he saved the other student's life,_ " [said the Guthrie Fire Department](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kLFuwyAURb_G3l6En8HYA0OXbOna0cLwMLQvBhmaKn9fpR_Q-V4dHZ2P23qzidOxv9s7mbCHtYW8okAFYgCUq7eJn6vsvQlESGNPZtCj1kpMqPpo5rCh9nYYxOTELFXwzslxkdO2uHkh0SfzookBJQrUSl6sm73CYRGknJuWpZOCfGr5vHzmdLRIgZ_5QefF5XvPJrZWaje-dXjt8FooF6bX1OE1pj1CdTFnhs3WL2qbZYbC9kknVPugCrmUfNDRKnAKBDY0OiESuMxsS309DnD5-2wwa62lVP1pfPlJzKlOupNiv9vEfzLtv0APg78BAAD__yira20). Vitales was taken to Children's Hospital in Oklahoma City, where he was successfully removed from a ventilator. The two students reunited recently, sharing hugs in an emotional meeting. [Watch the reunion here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kLEOpCAURb8GOwy8AR0Lim3sZtstDcJD2HmKEVbj329mkm23PSe5yT2_XtPLJkrb8tOuaMISphryBAI0F5KDmrxNdE-q8SYgAj4aNLJ_9L0WHegmGglPRBEcKj37oFw_dzBLPXS6RxBDaJL5rAkJCgT0WrXWPb0GOQjUznXDwJRAn2o-2t85bTVioDufeLQurw2ZWOte2OMHg5HBeF1Xu81uw6t8PINxS0usdPMPYjCeyWNmMOY32ZhXy2NaIi8u5kx8tuWNdbZEfCd748GLPbHwvO-5pG3hFe36T9lQ8eARuctEdi_oed54_YI_R-UAQzdI1UmtdXMYv1-JKJWuZ0osq030PVD_F_U08DcAAP__qV199Q).
## Chihuahua Becomes Marathon Sensation
Jellybean, a 6-year-old Chihuahua mix from Davis, California, is defying expectations as [a marathon-running sensation](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kLGOqzAQAL8Guo3MYmMoXLwmXV57JVrsBTtnbOQ4ifj7U-4Drh5pNJqv23yjEEPa_tPOZt3Wua55RoEKRAcoZ0chnrNsnVmZkfuWTad7rZUYULXeKFql0GIiKZUexCL7RWpJ1rpFUT-ObTAfm-hQokCt5IXs6BR2k2Bl7TBNjRTsQs3lcs8hVc9rPPOLy8XmvY3G13o8mv5fg9cGrwfnI_IHNXjdqVD1OUHMr5A2sD74J_knwZ1jPBemBJQceC6Q34kLUK28HxVqhqUwfUNhm4t7wKh1h1PfFuOOd4gxPAbdSLHtFOJvSP1rzsvgTwAAAP__LLFpog). Weighing just 9 pounds, she has completed six marathons alongside her owner, Andrew Owens, and is training to break her personal record in 2025. [Watch a video here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8z8FqrDAUxvGnSXYj8SQn6iKLCxdXnXZTKF1JTE40Q5wMTkbx7Yt9gG6_D37w_7oOVxtTvE_vdiETpjCUkAcQgBdRX0AN3sZ0DIp7E4iAJCdTN7JpUGhAPpsgUNoWsSUfxkDo9BhG9GClRkcIPJpTEzUoENCgqqxrPULdCULndNcxJcjHktfqluO9zBTSkTdaK5cXnsxcyuPJ5D8GPYN-3_fqyK_yGun8z8UWNzPZb0z-v33oMIL6fEvffDX-sceU4lM3TIlpsTH9kuWvzM3ATwAAAP__twVV2A). Adopted in 2020, Jellybean quickly embraced running, building stamina from short jogs to full marathons. She recently achieved her personal best time of 3 hours and 47 minutes at the Garmin Kansas City Marathon. "_Jellybean reminds us that potential isn't defined by appearances. It's about heart, determination, and the work we're willing to put in,_ " said Owens. Follow [Jellybean on Instagram here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8zz2OgzAQQOHT2F2QGfyzLlxsQ5dtt0QDHsNEBkdgBXH7VfYA6Z8-6f3ehzty5m3-wZVCmtNQUxlAgbmp9gZ6iMj5GrSMIREBdZJC6zrnjLJg5BIM6slYGG1CH42HrvXoR4dgnHfJdpLDW1MtaFDgjG5w-ooGWq_ITJP1XmhFkWvZm0fhrS6U8lVetDdTWWUOS63PQ3TfAnoB_XmeDW9HxXnH9V0I6B-U8zUSbmAbENDLPcTnyTnzYZ3Qal6R879WPx2-AvwFAAD__1RdU1E).
## Town Uses Giant Mirror to Steal Winter Sun
The remote Italian town of Viganella, which experiences 83 days without sunlight each winter due to its location in a steep valley, solved its seasonal darkness with an innovative solution: an 8-by-5-meter rotating mirror installed on a mountaintop. [See photos here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8j7FurDAQAL_GdD6ZtQ2PwsVr6C5tSrTYa9howSefRXR_H10-IP1oRvN5X-7Iwuf2gQeFvOWl5bKAAa9Nr8EtCVlei-tSyERAtqPQj3YcvRnAd3uwyaZkpomysyv6Ia2EDlYL4FZL1nUc3jbTgwMDo3c3jP-Sh34y5GMcpkk5Q4lbqbevwmfbKcurXFRvsRydhL21x1PZ_wpmBXPb6eAzRa5R6E0omC_e8CQR1NxQGE99sQhupIWbXl8a9cG1lqpg7mpIj28W4ecwKme2A1l-S-2v-yvATwAAAP__MsZfHA). The €100,000 mirror, designed by local architect Giacomo Bonzani and engineer Gianni Ferrari, reflects sunlight into the town's main square for six hours daily between November and February, when direct sunlight is blocked by surrounding mountains. The project has since inspired similar installations in other sunlight-deprived communities, including the Norwegian town of Rjukan, which implemented its own mirror system in 2013. [Watch a video here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8z81urCAYxvGrgd2YlxeQccHi5EzcNNPu2iVBPpQGh4kyGu--sRfQ7fMkv-T_dTd3m3J6jO92DjqO0dRYDALKC7ALCuNtyocR1OsYAgZOg2aKKyWhRUkn7TliVIPvgKFVAB0yFoerFDgwNQCjSZ8aMBQIqKRorLt6iayDIJ1ru44ICD7VsjTfJT3qFGI-yhaWxpWZZj3V-lwJ_0ewJ9jv-94c5VVfQzj_c7HVTYT3G-G3y_9Pto5vH2Z2BNtK-A1Xumj_3FPOaW0VETDONuVfu_7Vu2n8CQAA__-EzVbD).

| | _**Pres. Trump Returns to The White House, Gov. Braun Tackles Healthcare Reform**_
---
Friends, This week, the Indiana GOP is excited to report on the array executive orders signed by Governor Braun, aimed at bringing affordability and transparency to healthcare in Indiana. Hoosiers across our state have long suffered under an opaque and inadequate healthcare system, and our party is proud to support Governor Braun in his efforts to combat these failings and bring relief to millions of Hoosiers. The Indiana GOP, alongside millions of Americans, also celebrated President Donald J. Trump's inauguration and return to the White House on Monday. President Trump's administration has hit the ground running to resolve the crisis on our southern border, restore American energy dominance, end divisive DEI and illegal discrimination in the federal government, and reverse the many destructive executive orders instituted under the Biden administration. At Indiana GOP HQ, we’re proud to see that our Republican leaders here at home and in D.C. are delivering on the the agenda that propelled them to office. We are dedicated to continue supporting conservative leadership as they work to strengthen and protect our state and country, and are thrilled to see the progress that has already been made. Thank you for all you do!
---
| |
---
| | Erin Lucas, Indiana GOP Interim Chairwoman
---
|
---
|
---
| |

| | _**Governor Braun Tackles Healthcare Reform**_
---
---
**Governor Mike Braun** continued his efforts to stand for Hoosiers right out of the gate this week by signing several executive orders that lower costs, improve transparency and outcomes, and protect the sanctity of life. **What he said** : "Today, I signed nine executive orders that will make Indiana healthier by driving down healthcare costs, increasing access, and increasing transparency. We are committed to ensuring Hoosiers have the best healthcare available, and that the costs don’t break the bank." \- **Governor**** Braun** said via [X](http://links.email.in-gop.com/u/click?_t=9a0b7d408bc44ce9bb6828c91a267dbf&_m=fdb095f7a7f44415b93a05272c35c9d0&_e=vMalUOX63hkDDhad00s7PqdV6xEaOK731u6m3_ljsWBXoJKewqFnsi2_JcU__5ytyIaM6ZeUbjKwvBa4XY2J8nnzSu6-edtybNPsQGYulLn1SSN4n3yEMGCmIsE0hkUrIS28qWDPuJEVTmP2DFnCMnHZyNJ_3td5UGzm9wEB1hWGo508f-kNEzShc4-9b4XUkmiP6Wwgc06St69t2at8Ca67iLxv5MYUnozSDX6Im1w%3D).
---
**_Governor Braun Joined the Indianapolis March for Life_**
---
---
**Governor Mike Braun** joined hundreds of young people and leaders of faith, government, and the Pro-Life movement to stand for the sanctity of life and in support of families. The cold did not stop this amazing group of young people from around the state! **What he's saying** : "I had a great time braving the freezing temperatures to stand for LIFE at the Indiana March for Life! I joined the crowd after signing an executive order ensuring that our state’s pro-life laws are enforced to protect the unborn and support mothers and families."
\- **Governor**** Braun** said via [X](http://links.email.in-gop.com/u/click?_t=9a0b7d408bc44ce9bb6828c91a267dbf&_m=fdb095f7a7f44415b93a05272c35c9d0&_e=vMalUOX63hkDDhad00s7PgYJe3saMJlFmP_2WPhhUwQnaeyNXvWp6oQt-7paNRfsNdgDLvCT8mgZ5aQG_PpK69_YBOOcw15NgQXT-hvACg5OJpQ8CboLOuGTqvRC38FR5tP0qOFzO8VGi_7Y135mh79QJmuo7ArpjT1-hFs7j6eQ9V5jo0rSwDVUhvwxtc9c2uEl_m8CLSqjRMLYaU0yJRQ-tyirGJHoJJkblCNLGmE-Ld9RbBqC2W6Y-ALXVaRr).

#
Peter,

As you've most likely seen, parts of beautiful Southern California are being destroyed by ruthless flames.

My family and I are safe, but many are not. As we pray for the protection of all those in the fire's path, there is something else you can do to help these victims.

Live Action is partnering with EveryLife to send diapers to families impacted by the fires. From now through the end of the month, every gift of $50, using this link, will enable a box of diapers (6 packs!) to be sent to a family in critical need. Will you step up now for these families? [ ](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=a1bde9a2ffc146ff8922fe8ccd2d30bc&_e=WJsEE9d7_1Vy26vlL-MN4oKyQG01aIZDjPdXhzQJcC1_mGBOLHOQgQDtLxHDCorWQ8mdlVK6l6rFsJIRqYCZOtZDludy0kXl029c3cR8moIhkqBscjioGgHAlJVggilAES61p7qVhnzxCPdDnL5OV06943Q54_lOKRpEike69I7LMX1_m0q0OYemhPZZFso4PueG5rsCMb2RD7kNVoOfAL2hcVwJEGiT8-KO9Vo2J9a0i8UaCS1EHUHobOG70hhtarlAjUt7BObSPWJ19UAnTSMqiU8nIYvVMaoQH-NvlxBQXI-fDBvHlhGQVICRM72KVjFUASDJvOz02lu2_PoyUq2-l2QtoEDdy6VydI2ed6cWJa3CkSiL3S7yvGJf0Q9S)
With many already dead and over 2,000 buildings destroyed, news reports are saying this is one of the most destructive fires in recorded history for this region of California.

Over 130,000 have been evacuated so far and many are struggling to meet basic needs, unsure what they'll be returning to after the flames subside.

In these stressful moments, practical necessities make all the difference, especially when babies are involved. That's why we're partnering with EveryLife to provide diapers to families in need.

name: AOC
subject: We need to be brawlers for the working class.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
We have turned into a party that caters to the wealthy.
#
I believe that **we need to be a party of brawlers for the working class**.
And we have turned into a party that caters to people who _call_ themselves "upper middle class," but they're actually wealthy.
We've been chasing this affluent group, making all of these little concessions, and hoping that working people don't notice.
I think the most famous one that comes to mind is Kyrsten Sinema doing her little curtsy when she voted down the $15 minimum wage.
**But it wasn't just her**. That was the most public expression of it, but there were a bunch of Democrats in the Senate behind her that also voted it down.
People are struggling so much right now. **$15 an hour is nothing**.
The day I was assigned to the Energy and Commerce Committee, my staff's email inboxes blew up with lobbyists, just _tons_ of lobbyists, flooding our emails.
I don't take a dime of lobbyists' money. And because I am afforded that independence because everyday people support me, I'm under no pressure or obligation to take a _single_ one of these meetings. **Not one**.
And because of your grassroots support, we will stop at _nothing_ to push for real progress for working people these next four years.**

name: Team Long Run
subject: Sign on: Say NO to Pete Hegseth for Secretary of Defense
disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Long Run PAC, P
body:
He is unfit to serve as the head of our armed forces.
#
Friend, we told you a few weeks ago that there will be moments where we can successfully block Trump’s extremist agenda, and now one of those moments is already here.
As you may know, Trump’s nominee for Secretary of Defense, Fox News host Pete Hegseth, has been exposed for a long record of disqualifying personal and professional conduct.
Hegseth has made many racist and islamophobic statements and repeatedly engages with far-right extremist ideology. He has said clearly that he thinks women shouldn’t serve in the military and has been credibly accused of sexual assault. **He is unfit to serve as the head of our armed forces.**
Reports now show that a small handful of Republican Senators are considering voting against his confirmation, which would force Trump to go back to the drawing board and pick a new nominee.
So, we’re looking for the help of this team to put maximum pressure on the Senate to vote against Hegseth at **tonight’s confirmation vote.** We don’t have a lot of time, so we have to move fast.
[**Please, add your name and help us show key Senators who may be on the fence that people of all backgrounds are outraged about Hegseth’s potential confirmation >>**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/signup/hegseth_em_jan25/?source=em250124-1-180&akid=5465%2E196590%2E-q9rgv)
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/signup/hegseth_em_jan25/?source=em250124-1-180&akid=5465%2E196590%2E-q9rgv)
We’re looking to get at least 10,000 signatures by this afternoon to show that Hegseth cannot and should not be confirmed by the Senate.
Thank you for your help, as always,
The team at The Long Run

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you. He kicked off his second term with several actions to sharply turn the nation towards the right — just like he said he would.With moves that deepen economic inequality, attack vulnerable communities, and inflict harm through our immigration system, the future of our country feels bleak. Does it have to be?

In our hands we have the power to help shape our country and preserve democracy.

**Local, municipal ****and judicial elections** are going to be critical as they are the last line of defense. Organizations like the ACLU are already filing suits to protect our nation.We have the power to affect change on the ground by making sure our courts and local elected officials remain impartial.This year our work is more important than ever. #CourtsMatter #WhenWeVoteWeWin

| | On Rev Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Day, we also honored the legacy of Coretta Scott King, a remarkable woman who dedicated her life to fighting for justice and equality, alongside her husband, Martin Luther King Jr.

Some may argue Dr. King's legacy would not be what it is today without Mrs. King's work.

Coretta Scott King was an American author, activist, and civil rights leader who played a crucial role in the Civil Rights Movement. Her efforts also extended beyond civil rights, advocating for women's rights, LGBTQ rights, and an end to apartheid in South Africa.

Even after the tragic assassination of her husband in 1968, Coretta Scott King continued to be a powerful voice for change for 39 more years. She established the Martin Luther King, Jr. Center for Nonviolent Social Change to carry on their shared dream.

clean_body: | | | | | Hi Friend , Welcome to the latest New Pennsylvania Project newsletter! It's official, Donald Trump is President. He kicked off his second term with several actions to sharply turn the nation towards the right — just like he said he would.With moves that deepen economic inequality, attack vulnerable communities, and inflict harm through our immigration system, the future of our country feels bleak. Does it have to be? In our hands we have the power to help shape our country and preserve democracy. Local, municipal and judicial elections are going to be critical as they are the last line of defense. Organizations like the ACLU are already filing suits to protect our nation.We have the power to affect change on the ground by making sure our courts and local elected officials remain impartial.This year our work is more important than ever. #CourtsMatter #WhenWeVoteWeWin | | We need to hear from you | | | All of us know democracy works best when it works for everyone. That is why we want to hear about the issues you care about the most in 2025. Please, take a couple minutes to let us know how we can continue to empower our communities to get out and vote in ALL elections! | | | | | Why Courts Matter 201 Thursday January 30th 6:30-8:00PM Online via Zoom How do the courts affect our rights and freedoms? Why should we be involved in judicial elections? We will be hosting our second virtual town hall alongside Why Courts Matter - Pennsylvania , focusing on the importance of our state and federal courts. | | | | | | | In an article for The Keystone, published on January 20th, Sean Kitchen quoted New Pennsylvania Project's founding CEO, Kadida Kenner, saying: “I choose on this Jan. 20th to honor the legacy of Dr. King and the incomparable Coretta Scott King, who remind us that we need leaders who are in love with justice and not leaders who are in love with power and power grabs and injustice.” | | | | | Coat and Canned Soup Drive, Berrysburg, Dauphin County. New Pennsylvania Project’s founding CEO, Kadida Kenner, speaks about the importance of voting rights, civic engagement, upcoming judicial elections and democracy defense at a coat and canned soup drive event celebrating Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Day in rural Berrysburg, Dauphin County. | | | | | On Rev Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Day, we also honored the legacy of Coretta Scott King, a remarkable woman who dedicated her life to fighting for justice and equality, alongside her husband, Martin Luther King Jr. Some may argue Dr. King's legacy would not be what it is today without Mrs. King's work. Coretta Scott King was an American author, activist, and civil rights leader who played a crucial role in the Civil Rights Movement. Her efforts also extended beyond civil rights, advocating for women's rights, LGBTQ rights, and an end to apartheid in South Africa. Even after the tragic assassination of her husband in 1968, Coretta Scott King continued to be a powerful voice for change for 39 more years. She established the Martin Luther King, Jr. Center for Nonviolent Social Change to carry on their shared dream. Rev Dr Martin Luther King Jr Day | | | Staffers from the affiliated organization, New PA Project Education Fund (NPPEF), were on the ground last Monday, January 20th, 2025 at various "King Day" events across the Commonwealth. They engaged with exciting turnouts providing civic education on the importance of participating in our upcoming elections.We all honor Rev. Dr. King and Mrs. Scott King's legacy by practicing our right to vote. | | Philadelphia | | | | | | Large turnouts at a Martin Luther King Day Event at Girard College, Philadelphia. "The Pennsylvania Supreme Court said Friday it will again consider whether voters should have to write the accurate date on return envelopes used to send their completed mail-in ballots to be counted." "The declined on Tuesday to hear a bid by civil and voting rights groups to end Pennsylvania's mandate that mail-in ballots bear a handwritten date on the outer envelope, a requirement they contend is unnecessary and has resulted in needless disqualification of legitimate ballots." | | "On his first day in office, President Donald Trump former President Joe Biden’s 2021 executive order promoting voting access and expanding voter registration." "Buried deep within — the Heritage Foundation’s 900-page blueprint for how the new conservative administration can slide the government into an authoritarian regime — is a cursory section suggesting reforms for a relatively new, little-known federal agency called the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA). Formed in 2018 within the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), CISA is responsible for cybersecurity and infrastructure protection across the government." | | "A Republican House member introduced a resolution Thursday to amend the U.S. Constitution in order to allow President Donald Trump — and any other future president — to be elected to a third term in the White House.." body:
| | | | | |
---
| Peter- This week, America celebrated the inauguration of Donald J. Trump as President of the United States (for the second time). The inauguration itself was moved indoors inside the Capitol Rotunda, and President Trump’s speech outlined a vision for the next four years that will undoubtedly lead America down a better path than the last four. Whether it is his hyperfocus on combating the Mexican drug cartels or his rescinding of the disastrous executive orders of the Biden Administration, President Trump’s first week in office kicked off with a lot of promise.
Now, it’s time to get to work. Here’s your brief.
---
| | | |
---
| **PRESIDENT TRUMP'S MOST IMPORTANT PROMISE**
---
| |

| President Trump campaigned on a lot of promises. Lowering the cost of living, securing the border, restoring peace through American strength on the world stage, the list goes on. The promise I am most eager to help him deliver on is his promise to destroy the Mexican drug cartels.
This has been a primary focus of mine in Congress. I lead the Congressional Task Force to Combat the Mexican Drug Cartels, a bipartisan group of lawmakers organizing a strategy to take down this threat. My legislation to improve our targeting of support networks for the cartels was signed into law. And I’ve offered several pieces of legislation like an authorization for the use of military force against the cartels. Now that we have a President who is aligned with this priority, we can actually make significant headway in eliminating them.
A key piece to this equation, however, is the Mexican government itself. We can only do so much unilaterally from the United States government. We must have a partner in our neighbor to the south if we want to do what’s necessary to root out this threat. The Mexican government needs to want to eliminate the cartels as much as we do, and they have good reason to. The cartels operate as a terrorist insurgency throughout the country, killing politicians by the dozens and holding vast swaths of territory in Mexico.
President Trump is a master negotiator. I am confident that he will use a carrot-stick approach with Mexican leaders to persuade them into cooperating with our efforts to destroy this mutual enemy.
For Congress, it is up to our leaders in the House whether they want to match President Trump’s eagerness to take on the cartels. I have [proposed a select committee](https://ctrk.klclick2.com/l/01JJD3JGZDYVRKXJ4BGQXR0G3F_1) to combat the cartels, which will focus the House’s legislative efforts through one central body that will make it easier to pass legislation on the House floor.
This is a proposal I am vigorously advocating for, and I am hopeful we can get it done. It’s time to match our rhetoric with actual action.
